articles.title: Ukraine claims world’s first drone evacuation of wounded soldier
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: Ukraine has shared a video showing what it says is the world’s first evacuation of an injured soldier from the front lines by drone.
paras.zh: 乌克兰分享了一段视频，据称这是世界上首次通过无人机从前线撤离受伤士兵。

paras.en: The “historic” mission comes just as Kyiv faces a dire turn in its relationship with Washington over the withdrawal of support in its fight against Russia.
paras.zh: 这项“历史性”任务到来之际，基辅与华盛顿的关系因停止对俄罗斯的支持而面临严峻转变。

paras.en: Shared by the 92nd Separate Assault Brigade on Monday, the video shows the soldier strapping himself into a large drone and being flown at what appears to be relatively low altitude over blurred-out territory. The drone carefully lowers him, and the drone operator greets him with “Welcome back to the ground!” The video also shows blurred faces of drone operators who carried out the mission.
paras.zh: 周一，第 92 独立突击旅分享了这段视频，视频显示这名士兵将自己绑在一架大型无人机上，并在相对较低的高度飞行在模糊的区域上空。无人机小心地把他放下来，无人机操作员向他打招呼：“欢迎​​回到地面！”视频还显示执行任务的无人机操作员的面孔模糊。

paras.en: The post said the unidentified infantryman was wounded at his position. “Due to intense enemy drone activity and the presence of landmines, evacuation using conventional unmanned ground vehicles was impossible,” the brigade said.
paras.zh: 该帖子称，这名身份不明的步兵在其位置受伤。该旅表示：“由于敌方无人机活动频繁且地雷存在，使用传统无人地面车辆进行疏散是不可能的。”

paras.en: Injured Ukrainian soldier rescued with a drone
paras.zh: 无人机救起受伤乌克兰士兵

paras.en: “At that point, the specialists in our unit took it upon themselves to attempt something that had never been done before: evacuating a serviceman using an aerial drone,” it added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“那时，我们部队的专家亲自尝试了以前从未做过的事情：使用无人机疏散一名军人。”

paras.en: The craft was a heavy-lift hexacopter, it said, originally designed as a bomber by a Ukrainian manufacturer. It looks about twice the size of the soldier in the video.
paras.zh: 据称，这架飞机是一架重型六轴飞行器，最初由一家乌克兰制造商设计为轰炸机。它看起来大约是视频中士兵的两倍大。

paras.en: The specialists working on the mission had to ensure the drone could carry a human being without flipping over or swaying excessively, according to the unit.
paras.zh: 据该部门称，执行该任务的专家必须确保无人机能够载人，而不会翻转或过度摇摆。

paras.en: The rescued soldier is undergoing treatment and rehabilitation, the brigade added. The squad leader and programmer with the brigade, identified only by his call sign, Napalm, called the soldier a “hero” for agreeing to the mission, “having seen and heard the kind of machine that had arrived to get him.”
paras.zh: 该旅补充说，获救的士兵正在接受治疗和康复。该旅的班长兼程序员（仅通过呼号“凝固汽油弹”来识别）称这名同意执行任务的士兵为“英雄”，“看到并听到了来抓他的那种机器”。

paras.en: In a separate statement, Ukraine’s Ground Forces said its drone units are already conducting operations “that were recently considered science fiction.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰地面部队在另一份声明中表示，其无人机部队已经在开展“最近被视为科幻小说”的行动。

paras.en: The war has increasingly become a technological arms race, with both Ukraine and Russia relying on drones to reduce human casualties.
paras.zh: 这场战争日益成为一场技术军备竞赛，乌克兰和俄罗斯都依靠无人机来减少人员伤亡。

paras.en: The conflict has taken a severe toll on both armies, although neither side reports up-to-date numbers of those killed, injured or missing. Ukraine in particular has faced a severe shortage of manpower as it has tried to ramp up recruitment.
paras.zh: 冲突给双方军队造成了严重伤亡，但双方都没有报告最新的死亡、受伤或失踪人数。乌克兰尤其面临着严重的人力资源短缺，因为它试图增加招聘。

paras.en: Ukraine took a major leap in drone technology this year, allowing it to limit Russian logistics in occupied territories, as well as strike deeper inside Russia to target Russian oil refineries, commercial warehouses and data centers.
paras.zh: 乌克兰今年在无人机技术方面取得了重大飞跃，使其能够限制俄罗斯在被占领土上的物流，并深入俄罗斯境内打击俄罗斯炼油厂、商业仓库和数据中心。

paras.en: “This mission proves once again that Ukrainian service members, working in tandem with Ukrainian manufacturers, are setting global trends in the conduct of warfare,” the brigade’s statement added.
paras.zh: 该旅的声明补充道：“这次任务再次证明，乌克兰军人与乌克兰制造商合作，正在制定全球战争趋势。”

paras.en: Despite hoping its drone innovation would give it the upper hand at the negotiating table, Kyiv has faced pressure from the U.S. to halt its strikes on Russian oil sites after President Donald Trump signed a diesel deal with the Kremlin this month.
paras.zh: 尽管基辅希望其无人机创新能够使其在谈判桌上占据上风，但在唐纳德·特朗普总统本月与克里姆林宫签署柴油协议后，基辅面临美国要求其停止对俄罗斯石油基地的袭击的压力。

paras.en: Kyiv has since also reported gaps in intelligence sharing and restrictions on Elon Musk’s Starlink service, which is crucial for its drone missions, battlefield communications and air defense.
paras.zh: 此后，基辅还报告了情报共享方面的差距以及对埃隆·马斯克的星链服务的限制，该服务对其无人机任务、战场通信和防空至关重要。

paras.en: The drone evacuation comes just days after Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi announced the Ukrainian government had approved an “experimental project” to use drones for medical logistics. Koretskyi said that flights would require coordination with the military and that drones would be given a special status and be identifiable in the air.
paras.zh: 就在无人机撤离几天前，乌克兰总理谢尔希·科列茨基宣布乌克兰政府已批准一项使用无人机进行医疗物流的“实验项目”。科列茨基表示，飞行需要与军方协调，无人机将被赋予特殊地位并在空中可识别。

paras.en: “During the war, moving medical cargo by road can cost critical time, especially for transplants,” he said. “Drones will be able to carry medicines, medical products, blood samples and donor organs between hospitals, including from remote areas.”
paras.zh: “在战争期间，通过公路运输医疗货物可能会花费关键的时间，特别是对于移植手术来说，”他说。 “无人机将能够在医院之间（包括偏远地区）运送药品、医疗产品、血液样本和捐赠器官。”

articles.title: Dramatic images show violent unrest sweeping across France
articles.author: Roisín Savage

paras.en: Widespread violence erupted across France over the weekend, as rioters and looters ransacked storefronts, clashed with police and set fire to municipal buildings.
paras.zh: 周末，法国各地爆发了大范围的暴力事件，骚乱者和抢劫者洗劫店面，与警察发生冲突，并纵火焚烧市政建筑。

paras.en: Nearly 2,400 people were arrested and almost 1,000 police officers and firefighters were injured, the French Interior Ministry said, after some of the worst unrest the country has seen in years.
paras.zh: 法国内政部表示，在该国经历了多年来最严重的骚乱之后，近 2,400 人被捕，近 1,000 名警察和消防员受伤。

paras.en: In cities across the country, demonstrators set fire to newsstands and smashed windows. The violence followed weeks of largely peaceful protests over the cost of living and school conditions that expanded with an attempt to revive the “yellow vest” movement Saturday.
paras.zh: 在全国各地的城市，示威者放火焚烧报摊并砸碎窗户。暴力事件发生前，针对生活成本和学校条件的抗议活动持续了数周，基本上是和平的，周六，抗议活动规模扩大，试图复兴“黄背心”运动。

paras.en: In Limoges, a town in central France, dramatic scenes emerged overnight Saturday as rioters broke into the historic town hall and set it ablaze.
paras.zh: 在法国中部小镇利摩日，周六夜间，骚乱者闯入历史悠久的市政厅并将其纵火，戏剧性的场面出现。

paras.en: Aerial images the following morning revealed the smoldering remains of the 19th century building, which had survived two world wars, capping one of the most violent days in France’s recent history.
paras.zh: 第二天早上的航拍图像显示了这座 19 世纪建筑的闷烧残骸，该建筑在两次世界大战中幸存下来，结束了法国近代历史上最暴力的日子之一。

paras.en: Across the country in Lyon, southeastern France, an elderly man wearing a gas mask fled from tear gas at the Place des Terreaux on Saturday.
paras.zh: 周六，在法国东南部的里昂，一名戴着防毒面具的老人在沃土广场躲避催泪瓦斯。

paras.en: Crowds massed along the narrow streets of Paris throughout the weekend as masked demonstrators set up burning barricades near Place de la République, a major intersection through the city.
paras.zh: 整个周末，人群聚集在巴黎狭窄的街道上，蒙面示威者在巴黎的主要十字路口共和国广场附近设置了燃烧的路障。

paras.en: Striking scenes of disorder emerged from the French capital, including the monument at Place de la République where masked demonstrators burned flares and waved flags on Saturday.
paras.zh: 法国首都出现了引人注目的混乱场面，包括周六，蒙面示威者在共和广场的纪念碑上焚烧照明弹并挥舞旗帜。

paras.en: Nearby, a man with a crucifix bearing the message “Love will triumph” rested near a burning vehicle in central Paris.
paras.zh: 附近，巴黎市中心一辆燃烧的车辆旁，一名男子手持十字架，上面写着“爱将胜利”。

paras.en: French President Emmanuel Macron on Sunday vowed legal action against those responsible for the violence. “Those who sought to bring down the Republic will be held accountable,” he said.
paras.zh: 法国总统马克龙周日誓言对暴力事件的责任人采取法律行动。 “那些试图推翻共和国的人将被追究责任，”他说。

articles.title: Russia frees retired American teacher as Trump envoy meets with Putin
articles.author: Daniel Arkin

paras.en: Russia has released retired American teacher Stephen Hubbard, 74, the latest sign of warmer ties between the two countries as Washington pressures Kyiv to agree to a deal to end Moscow’s war.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯释放了 74 岁的美国退休教师斯蒂芬·哈伯德，这是两国关系回暖的最新迹象，华盛顿向基辅施压，要求其同意结束莫斯科战争的协议。

paras.en: U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff lauded President Vladimir Putin for the release of Hubbard as he held peace talks with the Russian leader early Wednesday in St. Petersburg. “You talk so much about my president, President Trump, being a humanitarian. You are a humanitarian also, sir,” Witkoff said.
paras.zh: 美国特使史蒂夫·维特科夫周三早些时候在圣彼得堡与俄罗斯领导人举行和平会谈时对弗拉基米尔·普京总统释放哈伯德表示赞赏。 “你经常谈论我的总统特朗普总统是一名人道主义者。先生，你也是一名人道主义者，”威特科夫说。

paras.en: The U.S. has courted the Kremlin for weeks, and the release of Hubbard — a Michigan native detained in Ukraine in 2022 — will give President Donald Trump a victory to tout after backlash at home and abroad for his tilt away from Kyiv in the conflict.
paras.zh: 美国几周来一直在向克里姆林宫示好，2022 年在乌克兰被拘留的密歇根人哈伯德的释放将为唐纳德·特朗普总统带来一场胜利，因为他在冲突中远离基辅而受到国内外的强烈反对。

paras.en: Trump hailed the news. “Stephen is on his way back home and will soon be with his family. The United States, out of respect for President Trump, was not required to give anything in return — an unprecedented situation for Russia,” he said in a post on Truth Social.
paras.zh: 特朗普对这一消息表示欢迎。 “斯蒂芬正在回国的路上，很快就会与家人团聚。出于对特朗普总统的尊重，美国不需要给予任何回报——这对俄罗斯来说是前所未有的情况，”他在《Truth Social》上发帖称。

paras.en: Trump said that he had directly asked Putin in a phone call last week to release Hubbard, who was being held on charges he denies of fighting as a mercenary in Ukraine. He was the last American designated as wrongfully detained in Russia by the State Department.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他上周在电话中直接要求普京释放哈伯德，哈伯德因否认在乌克兰作为雇佣军作战的指控而被拘留。他是最后一位被国务院认定为在俄罗斯被错误拘留的美国人。

paras.en: The Kremlin said the move was a goodwill gesture.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫表示此举是善意的姿态。

paras.en: Hubbard’s family thanked “President Trump and his team for opening the dialog with Russia which led to this joyful day. Our family can attest that there are wonderful blessings to be found along the hard road to peace.”
paras.zh: 哈伯德的家人感谢“特朗普总统和他的团队与俄罗斯展开对话，带来了这一欢乐的一天。我们的家人可以证明，在通往和平的艰难道路上可以找到美好的祝福。”

paras.en: Putin’s foreign policy aide Yuri Ushakov later said Hubbard was handed over to Witkoff at St. Petersburg’s Pulkovo airport.
paras.zh: 普京的外交政策助手尤里·乌沙科夫后来表示，哈伯德在圣彼得堡普尔科沃机场被移交给维特科夫。

paras.en: In a video from Russian state news agency Ria, Hubbard can be seen wearing a green jacket and smiling as he met Witkoff. “Thank you very much for all your efforts,” the freed American tells Witkoff as they shake hands. Putin sent Hubbard “blessings,” Witkoff tells him, adding “from today, it’s a new life.”
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯国家通讯社 Ria 发布的一段视频中，可以看到哈伯德身穿绿色夹克，在见到维特科夫时面带微笑。 “非常感谢你们所做的一切努力，”获释的美国人在与维特科夫握手时告诉维特科夫。威特科夫告诉哈伯德，普京向他送上了“祝福”，并补充说“从今天开始，这是新的生活”。

paras.en: Martin De Luca, Hubbard’s lawyer, told NBC News in a phone interview Wednesday that he had spoken with Hubbard as he was “getting ready to take off” on a plane bound for the U.S. and that his client was overjoyed to be released.
paras.zh: 哈伯德的律师马丁·德卢卡 (Martin De Luca) 在周三接受 NBC 新闻电话采访时表示，当哈伯德“准备起飞”飞往美国的飞机时，他与哈伯德进行了交谈，他的当事人对于获释感到非常高兴。

paras.en: “He was overwhelmed with joy,” De Luca said. “The No. 1 thing he was excited about was seeing his children and family, who will be waiting for him when he arrives in the U.S. tonight. He was in a fragile state, so it wasn’t a long conversation, but he’s OK, which is what’s important.”
paras.zh: “他欣喜若狂，”德卢卡说。 “他最兴奋的第一件事就是见到他的孩子和家人，当他今晚抵达美国时，他们会在等他。他的状态很脆弱，所以谈话时间并不长，但他没事，这才是重要的。”

paras.en: The meeting between Putin and Witkoff, which Trump son-in-law Jared Kushner was expected to join virtually, came after the American negotiators met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and European leaders in the Norwegian capital, Oslo.
paras.zh: 特朗普女婿贾里德·库什纳预计将虚拟参加普京和威特科夫的会晤，此前美国谈判代表在挪威首都奥斯陆会见了乌克兰总统泽连斯基和欧洲领导人。

paras.en: Ukraine brought forward new ideas and proposals at those talks, a U.S. official told NBC News, adding that “meaningful progress” was made as the Trump administration intensifies its peace push.
paras.zh: 一名美国官员告诉 NBC 新闻，乌克兰在这些会谈中提出了新的想法和建议，并补充说，随着特朗普政府加强和平推动，乌克兰取得了“有意义的进展”。

paras.en: Ushakov said Wednesday that Russia is ready to resume trilateral talks with the U.S. and Ukraine from mid-November, concerning “the establishment of a security system for Russia and Ukraine after the end of the conflict.”
paras.zh: 乌沙科夫周三表示，俄罗斯准备从11月中旬起恢复与美国和乌克兰的三边会谈，讨论“冲突结束后为俄罗斯和乌克兰建立安全体系”的问题。

paras.en: Zelenskyy told Fox News Wednesday that he would support talks involving himself, Trump and Putin, as well as direct Ukraine-Russia talks.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周三对福克斯新闻表示，他将支持他自己、特朗普和普京的会谈，以及乌克兰与俄罗斯的直接会谈。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Ushakov also said a separate proposed meeting of leaders from Russia, China and the U.S. during next month’s APEC summit in Shenzhen is “not rejected by any of the capitals.”
paras.zh: 与此同时，乌沙科夫还表示，俄罗斯、中国和美国领导人在下个月深圳亚太经合组织峰会期间举行单独会晤的提议“没有被任何国家的政府拒绝”。

paras.en: He said Russia had raised “several practical considerations regarding the content of possible trilateral talks” but “if circumstances are favorable, they, our Chinese friends, will certainly include this meeting in the program of events.”
paras.zh: 他表示，俄罗斯“就可能举行的三边会谈的内容提出了一些实际考虑”，但“如果情况有利，他们，我们的中国朋友，肯定会将这次会议纳入活动计划。”

paras.en: Diplomacy has made little headway for months, and the renewed American effort has drawn widespread criticism as Trump announced a series of moves to bolster Russia while Ukraine accused the U.S. of withdrawing crucial support.
paras.zh: 几个月来，外交几乎没有取得任何进展，随着特朗普宣布了一系列支持俄罗斯的举措，而乌克兰则指责美国撤回了关键的支持，美国的新努力招致了广泛的批评。

paras.en: “We want Zelenskyy to make a deal,” Trump told reporters in the Oval Office on Tuesday, intensifying a pressure campaign that has fueled concern the U.S. is no longer committed to Kyiv’s defense against the Russian invasion.
paras.zh: 特朗普周二在椭圆形办公室对记者表示：“我们希望泽连斯基达成协议。”他加大了施压力度，加剧了人们对美国不再致力于防御基辅抵御俄罗斯入侵的担忧。

paras.en: “We’ve given a lot to Ukraine. We’ve gotten absolutely nothing back except grief, death, tremendous monetary loss,” Trump said.
paras.zh: “我们为乌克兰付出了很多。除了悲伤、死亡和巨大的金钱损失，我们绝对没有得到任何回报，”特朗普说。

paras.en: Witkoff told Putin on Wednesday that “groundwork” had been laid for ending the fighting, and that he had brought documents outlining approaches to a possible deal.
paras.zh: 维特科夫周三告诉普京，结束战斗的“基础”已经奠定，他还带来了概述达成可能协议的方法的文件。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said that a potential trilateral leaders’ meeting was “one of the important ideas” raised in Oslo after Tuesday’s talks, which also included the leaders of Norway and Finland.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，可能举行的三边领导人会议是周二在奥斯陆举行的会谈后提出的“重要想法之一”，挪威和芬兰领导人也参加了会谈。

paras.en: Putin has so far insisted any meeting with Zelenskyy could only happen once a deal is finalized and take place in Moscow, a nonstarter for Ukraine. The Kremlin has also shown little sign of shifting from its hard-line demands, which include seizing Ukraine’s entire eastern Donbas region.
paras.zh: 普京迄今坚称，只有在协议敲定并在莫斯科举行后，与泽伦斯基的任何会面才会发生，这对乌克兰来说是不可能的。克里姆林宫也没有表现出任何改变其强硬要求的迹象，其中包括夺取乌克兰整个东部顿巴斯地区。

paras.en: Trump signed a diesel deal with Russia earlier this month and waived new sanctions on Moscow, drawing bipartisan criticism. He claimed Wednesday that negotiations to free Hubbard “would have come to a complete and total halt” if he hadn’t waived the sanctions.
paras.zh: 特朗普本月早些时候与俄罗斯签署了一项柴油协议，并放弃了对莫斯科的新制裁，引起了两党的批评。他周三声称，如果他不放弃制裁，释放哈伯德的谈判“将完全停止”。

paras.en: Kyiv, meanwhile, said it received no advance warning about at least three major Russian attacks and that restrictions on Elon Musk’s Starshield satellite service continue to hamper its aerial defenses and battlefield operations.
paras.zh: 与此同时，基辅表示，它没有收到有关至少三起俄罗斯重大袭击的预先警告，而且对埃隆·马斯克星盾卫星服务的限制继续阻碍其空中防御和战场行动。

paras.en: After the talks with Witkoff on Tuesday, Zelenskyy told reporters the recent issues with intelligence sharing had been resolved.
paras.zh: 周二与维特科夫会谈后，泽连斯基告诉记者，最近的情报共享问题已经解决。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio called the talks in Oslo “positive,” but said “nothing unexpected” came out of them.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥称奥斯陆会谈“积极”，但表示会谈“没有什么意外”。

paras.en: Rubio once again denied that the White House was behind any slowdown to Ukraine’s use of the internet service, saying this was an issue for Musk and SpaceX. Musk himself said last week any decision was down to Trump.
paras.zh: 卢比奥再次否认白宫是乌克兰使用互联网服务放缓的幕后黑手，称这是马斯克和 SpaceX 的问题。马斯克本人上周表示，任何决定都取决于特朗普。

paras.en: Deadly Russian attacks continued to hit Ukraine, meanwhile, with at least nine civilians killed across the country Wednesday as Moscow ramps up its strikes on energy infrastructure ahead of winter.
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯的致命袭击继续袭击乌克兰，周三，莫斯科在冬季前加大对能源基础设施的打击力度，全国至少有九名平民丧生。

paras.en: Authorities in Russia’s border Bryansk region said Wednesday that one person was killed in a Ukrainian strike.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯边境布良斯克地区当局周三表示，乌克兰的一次袭击造成一人死亡。

articles.title: Russell Brand treated 21yo woman 'like an animal' after rape, court hears
articles.author: Mazoe Ford

paras.en: Russell Brand's rape trial has heard evidence from his sixth accuser.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔·布兰德的强奸案审判已经听取了第六名原告的证据。

paras.en: London's Southwark Crown Court was told Mr Brand treated the woman "like an animal".
paras.zh: 伦敦南华克刑事法庭被告知布兰德先生“像对待动物一样”对待这名女子。

paras.en: The trial is expected to last at least six weeks.
paras.zh: 审判预计将持续至少六周。

paras.en: The jury in Russell Brand's criminal trial has heard from a woman who claims the celebrity raped her at his London home in 2009 and treated her "like an animal".
paras.zh: 拉塞尔·布兰德 (Russell Brand) 刑事审判的陪审团听取了一名女子的陈述，她声称这位名人 2009 年在他伦敦的家中强奸了她，并“像对待动物一样”对待她。

paras.en: Warning: this article contains details some readers may find distressing.
paras.zh: 警告：本文包含一些读者可能会感到痛苦的细节。

paras.en: The actor and comedian is before London's Southwark Crown Court on three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of indecent assault relating to six women in the United Kingdom across a decade from 1999.
paras.zh: 这位演员兼喜剧演员因自 1999 年起的十年间在英国对六名女性实施的三项强奸罪、三项性侵犯罪和一项猥亵罪向伦敦南华克刑事法院提起诉讼。

paras.en: Mr Brand, 51, has denied all the charges against him and previously told police that he never took part in non-consensual sexual activity.
paras.zh: 51 岁的布兰德否认了对他的所有指控，并此前告诉警方，他从未参与过未经同意的性活动。

paras.en: On Wednesday, local time, the jury was played more of the police interview of a woman who is the youngest of the six accusers.
paras.zh: 当地时间周三，陪审团更多地播放了警方对一名女性的采访，她是六名原告中最年轻的一名。

paras.en: She was 21 at the time of the alleged rape and Mr Brand was 33.
paras.zh: 涉嫌强奸时她 21 岁，布兰德先生 33 岁。

paras.en: In the video, she tells a detective she met Mr Brand after one of his live shows at the Hammersmith Apollo, and engaged in a consensual sex act with him in his dressing room.
paras.zh: 在视频中，她告诉一名侦探，她在哈默史密斯阿波罗剧院的一场现场表演后遇见了布兰德先生，并在他的更衣室里与他发生了两厢情愿的性行为。

paras.en: She said Mr Brand took her number and invited her to his house the following week.
paras.zh: 她说布兰德先生拿了她的电话号码并邀请她下周去他家。

paras.en: In the video and in court, she said that when she arrived they went upstairs to the bedroom, but he asked her to shower first.
paras.zh: 在视频和法庭上，她说，当她到达时，他们上楼去了卧室，但他让她先洗澡。

paras.en: "He asked me to shower because he said my hair smelt funny ... when I came out, he asked me to brush my teeth," the woman said.
paras.zh: “他让我洗澡，因为他说我的头发闻起来很奇怪......当我出来时，他让我刷牙，”该女子说。

paras.en: She said that what started as consensual sex, then changed suddenly into an activity she did not consent to, and she begged him to stop.
paras.zh: 她说，一开始是双方同意的性行为，后来突然变成了她不同意的行为，她恳求他停止。

paras.en: Under cross examination by Mr Brand's barrister Ian Winter KC, the woman agreed that in 2009 she was a "huge" Russell Brand fan.
paras.zh: 在布兰德先生的律师 Ian Winter KC 的盘问下，这名女子承认 2009 年她是拉塞尔·布兰德的“超级”粉丝。

paras.en: "I completely adored him, I was obsessed with him," she said of the famous comedian.
paras.zh: “我完全崇拜他，我对他着迷，”她谈到这位著名的喜剧演员时说道。

paras.en: Mr Winter put to her that those feelings and thoughts "clouded" her judgement and caused her to do things she would not have otherwise done.
paras.zh: 温特先生向她表示，这些感受和想法“模糊”了她的判断，导致她做出了原本不会做的事情。

paras.en: The woman acknowledged she went to his home willingly for what she expected to be consensual sex but added, "I didn't consent to what happened to me, I have said that repeatedly in the questioning ... I made it clear throughout all of my statements."
paras.zh: 该女子承认，她自愿去他家进行她所期望的双方同意的性行为，但补充道，“我不同意发生在我身上的事情，我在审问中反复说过……我在所有陈述中都明确表示了这一点。”

paras.en: The woman told the court that after Mr Brand raped her, the entertainer looked "horrified" and "told me to clean up the mess that I made", before pointing her to wet wipes kept in the bathroom.
paras.zh: 这名女子告诉法庭，布兰德先生强奸了她后，这位艺人看起来“很震惊”，并“告诉我清理我造成的混乱”，然后指给她看浴室里的湿纸巾。

paras.en: The jury was also played the video of the woman's second police interview where she speaks about a text message Mr Brand sent her after he spotted her at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival a few months later.
paras.zh: 陪审团还播放了该女子第二次接受警方讯问的视频，视频中她谈到了几个月后布兰德在爱丁堡边缘艺术节上发现她后发给她的一条短信。

paras.en: The woman told police she could not remember what Mr Brand's first message said but she replied, "why are you even messaging me?".
paras.zh: 这名女子告诉警方，她不记得布兰德先生的第一条消息说了什么，但她回答说：“你为什么还要给我发消息？”。

paras.en: She said he wrote back, "because you are dirty and I want to push you further".
paras.zh: 她说他回信说，“因为你很脏，我想把你推得更远”。

paras.en: "I said, 'I think you pushed me far enough, you treated me like an animal', and I remember his response was immediate, he said 'I'm sorry'."
paras.zh: “我说，‘我认为你把我逼得太远了，你像对待动物一样对待我’，我记得他的反应是立即的，他说‘我很抱歉’。”

paras.en: Mr Winter put to her: "You did not reply, did you, that 'you raped me'?" She replied: "No."
paras.zh: 温特先生问她：“你没有回答‘你强奸了我’吗？”她回答：“没有。”

paras.en: Mr Winter then said, "You replied, 'you pushed me far enough and you treated me like an animal'. And that's because he had pushed you and probably had treated you like an animal, but he didn't rape you."
paras.zh: 温特先生接着说，“你回答说，‘你把我推得太远了，你把我当作动物一样对待’。那是因为他推了你，可能把你当作动物一样对待，但他没有强奸你。”

paras.en: After the alleged assault, the woman said she told her close friends and her parents, who took her to a clinic for treatment, but she decided not to report the incident to police at the time.
paras.zh: 这名女子说，在发生所谓的袭击事件后，她告诉了她的密友和父母，他们带她去诊所接受治疗，但她当时决定不向警方报告这一事件。

articles.title: Australia’s cybersecurity site among those hit by ‘critical’ software flaw
articles.author: Thomas Morgan

paras.en: Two major vulnerabilities in programming language PHP have been discovered, and websites are being urged to implement a fix as soon as possible.
paras.zh: PHP 编程语言已发现两个重大漏洞，并敦促网站尽快修复。

paras.en: Australian government websites, including that of the Australian Signals Directorate, are affected.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚政府网站，包括澳大利亚信号局的网站，都受到了影响。

paras.en: It is believed hackers have been exploiting the vulnerability to target websites and governments around the world have taken sites offline.
paras.zh: 据信黑客一直在利用该漏洞攻击目标网站，世界各地的政府已使网站离线。

paras.en: Australia's own cybersecurity website is among services affected after an alert about a major vulnerability in a widely-used internet programming language that hackers are believed to be exploiting.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚自己的网络安全网站是受到有关广泛使用的互联网编程语言的重大漏洞的警报后受到影响的服务之一，据信黑客正在利用该漏洞。

paras.en: Developers of the PHP programming language have identified two critical vulnerabilities and have been urging website operators to run an update to fix the issues.
paras.zh: PHP 编程语言的开发人员已经发现了两个严重漏洞，并一直敦促网站运营商运行更新来解决这些问题。

paras.en: PHP underpins large parts of the internet, raising concerns that a significant number of websites could be vulnerable to attack.
paras.zh: PHP 支撑着互联网的大部分内容，这引发了人们对大量网站可能容易受到攻击的担忧。

paras.en: Among those known to be affected are European government departments and popular sites like Wikipedia.
paras.zh: 已知受影响的包括欧洲政府部门和维基百科等热门网站。

paras.en: The Australian Signals Directorate said on Wednesday that cyber.gov.au was among Australian government websites affected by a "critical" PHP issue.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚信号局周三表示，cyber.gov.au 是受到“严重”PHP 问题影响的澳大利亚政府网站之一。

paras.en: "Organisations and individuals using PHP within their environments should monitor and review PHP official guidance, and apply security patches as they become available," the ASD said on X.
paras.zh: ASD 在 X 上表示：“在其环境中使用 PHP 的组织和个人应监控和审查 PHP 官方指南，并在可用时应用安全补丁。”

paras.en: Government agencies in the Netherlands and Finland were among those that took sites offline ahead of the fix as a precaution.
paras.zh: 作为预防措施，荷兰和芬兰的政府机构在修复之前关闭了网站。

paras.en: "PHP is everywhere. It quietly powers WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, and Magento sites, shared hosting platforms, control panels, and an awful lot of software that doesn't even advertise that it runs PHP under the hood," cybersecurity company Huntress said in a blog post.
paras.zh: “PHP 无处不在。它悄悄地为 WordPress、Drupal、Joomla 和 Magento 网站、共享托管平台、控制面板以及大量软件提供支持，这些软件甚至没有宣传它在幕后运行 PHP，”网络安全公司 Huntress 在一篇博客文章中表示。

paras.en: Dane Knecht, the chief technology officer of Web and cloud security firm Cloudflare, said that attacks were emerging and Cloudflare was updating its firewall rules as a stopgap measure.
paras.zh: Web 和云安全公司 Cloudflare 的首席技术官 Dane Knecht 表示，攻击不断出现，Cloudflare 正在更新其防火墙规则作为权宜之计。

paras.en: "We are seeing early attacks emerging and are updating mitigations as new vectors show up. This is a STOPGAP only. Patch as soon as PHP releases the update," he said on X.
paras.zh: “我们看到早期攻击不断出现，并随着新载体的出现而更新缓解措施。这只是权宜之计。PHP 发布更新后立即修补，”他在 X 上说道。

paras.en: Cybersecurity agencies in Europe, Australia, Japan and Britain have urged PHP users to update immediately or take websites offline until patches can be applied.
paras.zh: 欧洲、澳大利亚、日本和英国的网络安全机构已敦促 PHP 用户立即更新或使网站离线，直到可以应用补丁为止。

paras.en: The Dutch cybersecurity agency itself went offline, saying it had done so as a precaution because of the vulnerabilities.
paras.zh: 荷兰网络安全机构本身也下线了，称这样做是出于预防措施，因为存在漏洞。

paras.en: Officials have said that all PHP versions from PHP 5 onward could be affected, although PHP has not yet disclosed which versions are vulnerable.
paras.zh: 官方表示，从 PHP 5 开始的所有 PHP 版本都可能受到影响，但 PHP 尚未透露哪些版本容易受到影响。

paras.en: PHP is a programming language used to run websites. When a visitor loads a page, a server running PHP assembles the content and sends it to the browser. It is free, open-source software maintained by volunteers.
paras.zh: PHP 是一种用于运行网站的编程语言。当访问者加载页面时，运行 PHP 的服务器会组装内容并将其发送到浏览器。它是由志愿者维护的免费开源软件。

paras.en: It is also among the most widely used software on the internet.
paras.zh: 它也是互联网上使用最广泛的软件之一。

paras.en: PHP runs roughly 75 per cent of websites whose programming language can be identified, according to web technology tracker W3Techs.
paras.zh: 根据网络技术跟踪机构 W3Techs 的数据，大约 75% 的可识别编程语言的网站都使用 PHP 运行。

paras.en: It is the engine behind WordPress, which powers about 43 per cent of all websites from blogs and small business pages to government portals, online stores and news sites.
paras.zh: 它是 WordPress 背后的引擎，为大约 43% 的网站提供支持，从博客和小型企业页面到政府门户网站、在线商店和新闻网站。

paras.en: Security experts said the vulnerabilities could potentially open the door to millions of servers because so many websites rely on the same underlying software.
paras.zh: 安全专家表示，这些漏洞可能会为数百万台服务器打开大门，因为许多网站都依赖相同的底层软件。

paras.en: Rather than target victims individually, attackers could scan the internet for systems running vulnerable versions of PHP.
paras.zh: 攻击者可以扫描互联网以查找运行易受攻击的 PHP 版本的系统，而不是单独针对受害者。

paras.en: Danish municipal IT company Kombit said it had shut down several services, including the national school communication platform, a spokesperson told Reuters.
paras.zh: 丹麦市政 IT 公司 Kombit 发言人告诉路透社，该公司已关闭多项服务，包括国家学校通信平台。

paras.en: Disruption was even more widespread in Finland, where state IT services provider Valtori said government public network services had been taken offline "as a precautionary measure."
paras.zh: 芬兰的中断情况更为普遍，芬兰国家 IT 服务提供商 Valtori 表示，“作为预防措施”，政府公共网络服务已被关闭。

paras.en: France's Interior Ministry said it had temporarily taken local government administrative websites offline while awaiting a security fix.
paras.zh: 法国内政部表示，在等待安全修复期间，已暂时关闭地方政府行政网站。

paras.en: The US cybersecurity agency CISA did not respond to emails seeking comment.
paras.zh: 美国网络安全机构 CISA 没有回复寻求置评的电子邮件。

articles.title: OpenAI says its AI agents disabled their own safety monitors

paras.en: OpenAI says its AI agents disabled their own safety monitors
paras.zh: OpenAI 表示其人工智能代理禁用了自己的安全监视器

paras.en: Two OpenAI agents disabled or weakened tools used to detect incidents of AI agents acting against human commands.
paras.zh: 两个 OpenAI 代理禁用或削弱了用于检测 AI 代理违反人类命令事件的工具。

paras.en: The two instances happened earlier this month, with one later telling its programmer it had not stripped out its monitor.
paras.zh: 这两起事件发生在本月早些时候，其中一件事后来告诉程序员，它没有拆掉显示器。

paras.en: The incidents adds to mounting disease about how well AI companies are controlling their autonomous systems.
paras.zh: 这些事件加剧了人们对人工智能公司对其自主系统控制能力的质疑。

articles.title: Australian MP loses both legs after alleged vehicle attack as suspect appears in court

paras.en: Australian MP loses both legs after alleged vehicle attack as suspect appears in court
paras.zh: 澳大利亚议员因涉嫌车辆袭击而失去双腿，嫌疑人出庭

paras.en: Politician's husband says his wife is stable
paras.zh: 政治家的丈夫说他的妻子很稳定

paras.en: Australian lawmaker Helen Haines has had both legs amputated after being rammed by a car outside her electoral office, her husband said on Wednesday, as the man accused of the attack appeared in court.
paras.zh: 周三，澳大利亚议员海伦·海恩斯 (Helen Haines) 在选举办公室外被一辆汽车撞倒后双腿被截肢，而被指控袭击的男子则出庭。

paras.en: Doctors amputated Haines's left leg after she was struck twice by a car in Wangaratta, northeast of Melbourne, on Monday, Phil Haines said. They worked for days to save her right leg but were ultimately unsuccessful, he told a news conference in Melbourne.
paras.zh: 菲尔·海恩斯说，周一，海恩斯在墨尔本东北部的旺加拉塔被一辆汽车撞了两次，医生将她的左腿截肢。他在墨尔本的新闻发布会上说，他们花了几天的时间来挽救她的右腿，但最终没有成功。

paras.en: "The good news in all this is Helen is alive and she's stable. That is the most important thing for our family," he said.
paras.zh: “好消息是海伦还活着，而且情况稳定。这对我们一家来说是最重要的，”他说。

paras.en: Brendan Nugent, a 43-year-old resident of the rural town of Tarrawingee within Haines's electorate, was charged with three offences: dangerous driving causing serious injury, intentionally causing serious injury, and causing harm to a public official.
paras.zh: 布伦丹·纽金特 (Brendan Nugent) 是海恩斯选区塔拉温吉 (Tarrawingee) 乡村小镇的 43 岁居民，被指控犯有三项罪名：危险驾驶造成严重伤害、故意造成严重伤害以及伤害公职人员。

paras.en: Additional charges of cannabis cultivation and possession have also been laid against Nugent, court filings showed.
paras.zh: 法庭文件显示，纽金特还受到种植和持有大麻的额外指控。

paras.en: Phil Haines, left, Haines's husband, speaks to reporters alongside Australia's Governor General Sam Mostyn in Melbourne. (William West/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 海恩斯的丈夫菲尔·海恩斯（左）在墨尔本与澳大利亚总督萨姆·莫斯廷一起接受记者采访。 （威廉·韦斯特/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: The suspect was restrained by members of the public at the scene before being arrested.
paras.zh: 嫌疑人在被捕前被现场公众制服。

paras.en: Haines, an independent lawmaker who has championed causes including climate change and regional housing, remains in critical condition.
paras.zh: 海恩斯是一名独立议员，一直倡导气候变化和地区住房等事业，目前仍处于危急状态。

paras.en: Police are still investigating the motive for the rare attack on an elected official.
paras.zh: 警方仍在调查这起罕见的针对民选官员的袭击事件的动机。

paras.en: During a brief court appearance on Wednesday, the accused's lawyer said his client suffers from a rare neurological condition called idiopathic transverse myelitis and was also being treated for concussion, the Australian Broadcasting Corporation reported. His lawyer told the magistrate his client had some mental health concerns and that it was his first time in custody.
paras.zh: 据澳大利亚广播公司报道，被告律师在周三短暂出庭时表示，他的当事人患有一种罕见的神经系统疾病，称为特发性横贯性脊髓炎，并且正在接受脑震荡治疗。他的律师告诉地方法官，他的当事人有一些心理健康问题，这是他第一次被拘留。

paras.en: There was no application for bail, and the case was deferred until Feb. 4.
paras.zh: 没有人申请保释，案件被推迟到2月4日审理。

paras.en: Anti-terrorism police are among the agencies investigating the incident. While police allege the attack was "targeted," they say they believe it was an isolated incident.
paras.zh: 反恐警察是调查该事件的机构之一。虽然警方声称这次袭击是“有针对性的”，但他们认为这是一起孤立事件。

paras.en: There was no intelligence to suggest any threat to Haines, and the Australian Federal Police received no warning of any imminent danger from the alleged attacker, Commissioner Krissy Barrett told reporters.
paras.zh: 专员克里斯·巴雷特告诉记者，没有情报表明海恩斯受到任何威胁，澳大利亚联邦警察也没有收到涉嫌袭击者有任何迫在眉睫的危险的警告。

paras.en: "What I can say is we didn't have any specific intelligence that would have indicated something as atrocious as happened on Monday afternoon," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“我能说的是，我们没有任何具体情报表明发生了周一下午发生的残暴事件。”

paras.en: Victoria state police said they could not find any direct past contact between Haines and the accused, with the motive still unknown.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州警方表示，他们找不到海恩斯与被告之间过去的任何直接接触，动机仍不清楚。

paras.en: "Motivation is one of these things that we absolutely need to explore. His motivation for this, what we allege is a deliberate attack, is very much a centerpiece of the investigation," Victoria Police Chief Mike Bush said.
paras.zh: “动机是我们绝对需要探索的事情之一。我们称他为故意袭击，他的动机是调查的核心，”维多利亚警察局长迈克·布什说。

paras.en: Bush declined to comment on the man's mental health, saying the matter was before the court.
paras.zh: 布什拒绝就该男子的心理健康状况发表评论，称此事已提交法庭审理。

paras.en: Haines had worked in nursing, midwifery and academia before being elected to Parliament in 2019 for the rural seat of Indi, which she retained in both 2022 and 2025.
paras.zh: 海恩斯曾在护理、助产和学术界工作过，之后于 2019 年当选为印迪农村选区议员，并于 2022 年和 2025 年连续两年当选议员。

paras.en: Violent attacks on politicians are rare in Australia, where federal lawmakers, state leaders and even prime ministers are often seen shopping, grabbing coffee or attending community events with relatively little security.
paras.zh: 在澳大利亚，针对政客的暴力袭击很少见，联邦立法者、州领导人甚至总理经常在安全相对较差的情况下购物、喝咖啡或参加社区活动。

paras.en: However, concerns about politicians' safety have grown in recent years amid rising political polarization, online abuse and threats against elected officials, prompting calls for greater protections while preserving the accessibility that has long characterized Australian politics.
paras.zh: 然而，近年来，随着政治两极分化、网络滥用和针对民选官员的威胁不断加剧，人们对政客安全的担忧日益加剧，这促使人们呼吁加强保护，同时保持澳大利亚政治长期以来的特点。

articles.title: U.S. envoy Witkoff meets with Putin in Russia amid report Musk throttled Starlink

paras.en: U.S. envoy Witkoff meets with Putin in Russia amid report Musk throttled Starlink
paras.zh: 美国特使威特科夫在俄罗斯会见普京，有报道称马斯克扼杀了星链

paras.en: U.S. envoy praises Putin as a 'humanitarian,' after Russia releases imprisoned American
paras.zh: 俄罗斯释放被监禁的美国人后，美国特使称赞普京是“人道主义者”

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin hosted U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff in a grand imperial palace on Wednesday to review new ideas on ending the war in Ukraine amid Washington's latest push to stop Europe's bloodiest conflict since the Second World War.
paras.zh: 周三，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在一座宏伟的皇宫接待了美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫，审查有关结束乌克兰战争的新想法，同时华盛顿为制止欧洲自第二次世界大战以来最血腥的冲突而采取了最新行动。

paras.en: The three-hour talks at the Constantine Palace in St. Petersburg were the ninth time that Witkoff has met Putin in person, and come amid concerns in Kyiv and among its allies that the United States is backing away from Ukraine, at times holding back real-time intelligence on Russian attacks.
paras.zh: 在圣彼得堡君士坦丁宫举行的为期三个小时的会谈是威特科夫第九次亲自会见普京，此次会谈正值基辅及其盟友担心美国正在从乌克兰撤退，有时会隐瞒有关俄罗斯袭击的实时情报。

paras.en: Putin told Witkoff that Moscow is willing in principle to resume talks next month with Ukraine and the U.S. on ending the war in Ukraine, Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov said. No such talks have taken place since February.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫助手尤里·乌沙科夫表示，普京告诉威特科夫，莫斯科原则上愿意下个月与乌克兰和美国恢复关于结束乌克兰战争的谈判。自二月份以来就没有举行过此类会谈。

paras.en: Russia began the talks with a goodwill gesture — the release of a retired U.S. school teacher, Stephen Hubbard.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯以善意姿态开始谈判——释放美国退休教师斯蒂芬·哈伯德。

paras.en: The 74-year-old Michigan native was first detained in April 2022 over allegations he had been manning a military checkpoint in Izyum, Ukraine, where he had resided for nearly a decade. Hubbard denied the charges but was later sentenced to six years and 10 months in prison.
paras.zh: 这位 74 岁的密歇根人于 2022 年 4 月首次被拘留，原因是他被指控在乌克兰伊久姆的一个军事检查站执勤，他在那里居住了近十年。哈伯德否认了这些指控，但后来被判处六年零十个月监禁。

paras.en: Stephen Hubbard is shown in the Moscow City court on Oct. 7, 2024. The American disputed the charges that led to his imprisonment. (Moscow City Court Press Service/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 2024 年 10 月 7 日，斯蒂芬·哈伯德出现在莫斯科市法院。这位美国人对导致他入狱的指控提出异议。 （莫斯科市法院新闻处/美联社）

paras.en: "You talk so much about my president, President Trump, being a humanitarian. You are a humanitarian also, sir, and I salute that," Witkoff said in response to Putin, who has been subject to an International Criminal Court arrest warrant since 2023, for the alleged unlawful deportation of children and unlawful transfer of people from Ukraine.
paras.zh: 维特科夫在回应普京时说：“你大肆谈论我的总统特朗普总统是一名人道主义者。先生，你也是一名人道主义者，我对此表示敬意。”普京自 2023 年以来因涉嫌非法驱逐儿童和非法从乌克兰转移人员而受到国际刑事法院的逮捕令。

paras.en: Witkoff flew into Russia a day after conducting what a U.S. official called "constructive" talks in Oslo with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, the leaders of Finland and Norway and European and NATO representatives.
paras.zh: 维特科夫在奥斯陆与乌克兰总统泽连斯基、芬兰和挪威领导人以及欧洲和北约代表进行了美国官员所说的“建设性”会谈后一天飞往俄罗斯。

paras.en: A real estate magnate like Trump, Witkoff had no diplomatic experience before last year. Democrats have raised concerns about the potential conflicts of interest for Witkoff and fellow envoy Jared Kushner, given their extensive global business interests.
paras.zh: 作为特朗普这样的房地产大亨，维特科夫在去年之前没有任何外交经验。鉴于威特科夫和特使贾里德·库什纳广泛的全球商业利益，民主党人对他们潜在的利益冲突表示担忧。

paras.en: Putin has shown few signs of compromising on his central war aims, which include full Russian control of the Donetsk region in eastern Ukraine and no NATO membership for Kyiv.
paras.zh: 普京几乎没有表现出对其核心战争目标妥协的迹象，其中包括俄罗斯完全控制乌克兰东部的顿涅茨克地区以及基辅不加入北约。

paras.en: 'Either the president was lying or Musk was lying'
paras.zh: “要么总统在撒谎，要么马斯克在撒谎”

paras.en: U.S.-Ukraine ties have deteriorated sharply since Trump announced a diesel export deal with Russia earlier this month to help lower prices in the United States. High fuel costs since he launched strikes on Iran have hurt his Republicans ahead of midterm elections on Nov. 3.
paras.zh: 自特朗普本月早些时候宣布与俄罗斯达成柴油出口协议以帮助降低美国价格以来，美国与乌克兰的关系急剧恶化。自他对伊朗发动袭击以来，高昂的燃料成本在 11 月 3 日中期选举之前伤害了他的共和党人。

paras.en: Since the diesel deal, Ukraine has complained of disruption to some intelligence sharing and to its use of the Starshield military satellite system, though Zelenskyy said that Tuesday's Oslo meeting had reached an agreement to resolve those issues.
paras.zh: 自达成柴油协议以来，乌克兰抱怨一些情报共享和星盾军事卫星系统的使用受到干扰，尽管泽连斯基表示周二的奥斯陆会议已达成解决这些问题的协议。

paras.en: Citing U.S. officials and people familiar with the matter, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday that billionaire Elon Musk had last week ordered the slowdown of the service, which is essentially a military-grade version of Starlink developed for the Pentagon.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》周三援引美国官员和知情人士的话报道称，亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克上周下令放慢该服务的速度，该服务本质上是为五角大楼开发的星链的军用级版本。

paras.en: Throttling the speed of the satellite service, according to Ukraine officials, hampers its ability to conduct strikes on Russian targets and to defend itself from Russian drones using its own interceptor drones.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员表示，限制卫星服务的速度会妨碍其对俄罗斯目标进行打击以及使用自己的拦截无人机防御俄罗斯无人机的能力。

paras.en: Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
paras.zh: 路透社无法立即核实该报道。

paras.en: Democratic Sen. Adam Schiff of California called for the Senate to compel Musk to testify under oath in the wake of the Journal's report.
paras.zh: 在《华尔街日报》报道后，加利福尼亚州民主党参议员亚当·希夫呼吁参议院迫使马斯克宣誓作证。

paras.en: "National security decisions should be made in our national security interests, and not based on the personal whim of an unstable executive," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“国家安全决策应该基于我们的国家安全利益，而不是基于不稳定的行政人员的个人想法。”

paras.en: - Starlink restrictions would hamper Ukraine's war effort. But the country can adapt, experts say
paras.zh: - 星链限制将阻碍乌克兰的战争努力。但专家表示，国家可以适应

paras.en: "Either the president was lying or Musk was lying, but the decision to slow down satellite speed and access has life-or-death consequences for Ukraine," said Schiff.
paras.zh: 希夫说：“要么是总统在撒谎，要么是马斯克在撒谎，但减慢卫星速度和访问速度的决定对乌克兰来说具有生死攸关的后果。”

paras.en: Trump remained frustrated with Zelenskyy, whom he has repeatedly rebuked and suggested needs to be replaced, in White House comments on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 特朗普仍然对泽伦斯基感到失望，他在周二的白宫评论中多次斥责泽伦斯基，并建议需要更换他。

paras.en: "He's going to have to want to make a deal, because I don't think his people are going to stand for it any longer," Trump told reporters on the eve of the talks in Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普在俄罗斯会谈前夕对记者表示：“他必须想要达成协议，因为我认为他的人民不会再支持它了。”

paras.en: Ukraine held back for several days last week from hitting Russian oil refineries in deference to Trump's request to help with diesel costs, but has resumed strikes after Russia showed no sign of complying. Both sides have also struck data centres.
paras.zh: 乌克兰上周因尊重特朗普帮助降低柴油成本的要求而没有对俄罗斯炼油厂进行打击，但在俄罗斯没有表现出遵守的迹象后，乌克兰恢复了打击。双方还袭击了数据中心。

paras.en: Trump has said little about Russia's far more severe attacks on Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特朗普对俄罗斯对乌克兰发动的更为严厉的袭击只字未提。

paras.en: "Russia, frankly, has been fine on Ukraine," he said Monday.
paras.zh: “坦率地说，俄罗斯在乌克兰问题上一直很好，”他周一表示。

paras.en: Trump has had an often-contentious relationship with Ukraine's president, dating back to 2019 when he was impeached, but then acquitted, for pressuring Zelenskyy for a domestic political favour to discredit rival Joe Biden in exchange for military aid for Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特朗普与乌克兰总统的关系经常存在争议，可以追溯到2019年，当时他因向泽伦斯基施压，要求其提供国内政治支持，抹黑竞争对手乔·拜登，以换取对乌克兰的军事援助，从而被弹劾，但随后被无罪释放。

paras.en: In fresh fighting, two Ukrainians over 80 years old were among four killed in overnight Russian attacks that also targeted energy facilities across four regions, officials said. The senior citizens were killed just outside the northeastern city of Kharkiv, while the two other fatalities occurred in Kyiv, where a drone slammed into an apartment building.
paras.zh: 官员称，在新的战斗中，俄罗斯隔夜袭击也针对四个地区的能源设施，造成四人死亡，其中包括两名 80 岁以上的乌克兰人。这些老年人在东北部城市哈尔科夫郊外被杀，另外两人死亡则发生在基辅，一架无人机撞向一栋公寓楼。

paras.en: A first responder walks on debris at the site of an apartment building in Kyiv, which was damaged during a Russian drone strike, on Tuesday. (Gleb Garanich/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周二，基辅一栋公寓楼在俄罗斯无人机袭击中受损，一名急救人员踩在废墟上。 （格莱布·加兰尼奇/路透社）

paras.en: Ukrainian Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi said Russia had attacked power facilities in the Kyiv, Volyn, Odesa and Mykolaiv regions, as well as civilian enterprises in at least two others.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总理谢尔盖·科列茨基表示，俄罗斯袭击了基辅、沃林、敖德萨和尼古拉耶夫地区的电力设施，以及至少另外两个地区的民用企业。

paras.en: Russia's Defence Ministry said its forces had hit a warehouse complex used for drone storage in the central Ukrainian city of Poltava, and an electric power substation, which supplies power to Ukrainian defence and industrial sector as well as logistics centres in Kyiv. It also said it had hit a ship carrying military cargo to Ukraine heading to the port of Odesa.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部表示，其部队袭击了乌克兰中部城市波尔塔瓦的一个用于存放无人机的仓库综合体，以及一个为乌克兰国防和工业部门以及基辅物流中心供电的变电站。它还表示，它击中了一艘运往乌克兰、前往敖德萨港的军用货物的船只。

paras.en: The strikes are part of a mounting campaign by Moscow to knock out the Ukrainian energy grid as winter approaches.
paras.zh: 这些罢工是莫斯科在冬季来临之际不断加大力度摧毁乌克兰能源网的行动的一部分。

articles.title: Ohio's Vivek Ramaswamy slammed for 'revolting' campaign ad featuring opponent's estranged mother

paras.en: Ohio's Vivek Ramaswamy slammed for 'revolting' campaign ad featuring opponent's estranged mother
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州的维韦克·拉马斯瓦米因以对手疏远的母亲为主角的“令人反感”的竞选广告而受到猛烈抨击

paras.en: Candidate Amy Acton, brother were removed from mother's custody after stepfather charged with abuse
paras.zh: 继父被控虐待后，候选人艾米·阿克顿和兄弟被解除母亲的监护权

paras.en: The ad introduces a deeply personal element into one of the country's most closely watched and expensive campaigns for state office. Questions about the video will likely shadow Ramaswamy in the final two weeks of the contest, with Democrats branding it as a desperate move.
paras.zh: 这则广告将深刻的个人元素引入到该国最受关注、最昂贵的州政府竞选活动之一中。有关该视频的问题可能会在竞选的最后两周给拉马斯瓦米带来阴影，民主党人将其视为孤注一掷的举动。

paras.en: More than 676,000 people have already cast ballots in Ohio ahead of the Nov. 3 midterms.
paras.zh: 在 11 月 3 日中期选举之前，已有超过 676,000 人在俄亥俄州投票。

paras.en: Arthur lost custody of her children after their stepfather was indicted for raping Acton. The Democratic candidate has not seen her mother, whose last known address was in Pennsylvania, since they were both in a courtroom in 1978.
paras.zh: 在继父被指控强奸阿克顿后，亚瑟失去了孩子们的监护权。这位民主党候选人自 1978 年同在法庭以来就没有见过她的母亲，她最后的已知地址在宾夕法尼亚州。

paras.en: Connie Luck, a spokesperson for Ramaswamy's campaign, said Acton's mother was not paid for the one-minute video, which she said will stream online and air on television.
paras.zh: 拉马斯瓦米竞选活动发言人康妮·拉克表示，阿克顿的母亲没有为这段一分钟的视频付费，她说该视频将在网上播放并在电视上播出。

paras.en: Democratic candidate Amy Acton speaks during a campaign event at Ohio University in Athens, Ohio, on Sept. 17, (Carolyn Kaster/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 9 月 17 日，民主党候选人艾米·阿克顿在俄亥俄州雅典市俄亥俄大学举行的竞选活动中发表讲话（卡罗琳·卡斯特/美联社）

paras.en: Ramaswamy's campaign initially issued a statement that did not address whether he was responsible for the ad or knew who produced it. In the earlier statement, Luck said Acton was a "serial fabulist who has some serious problems with the truth that the public needs to be aware of."
paras.zh: 拉马斯瓦米的竞选团队最初发表了一份声明，没有说明他是否对这则广告负责，也没有知道是谁制作的。拉克在早些时候的声明中表示，阿克顿是一位“连环寓言作家，他对公众需要了解的事实存在一些严重问题”。

paras.en: The video's origins were initially murky when it started circulating online. It did not include the "paid for" tag that is legally required to air on television so viewers can know who produced and paid for it.
paras.zh: 该视频开始在网上流传时，其来源最初是模糊的。它不包括法律要求在电视上播放的“付费”标签，以便观众可以知道是谁制作并付费的。

paras.en: Acton, Ohio's former public health director, has made no secret of facing homelessness and abuse as a child. She spent Tuesday condemning Ramaswamy for the ad even before his campaign confirmed its origins.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州前公共卫生主任阿克顿毫不掩饰童年时期面临的无家可归和虐待问题。周二，她甚至在拉马斯瓦米的竞选活动证实其来源之前就谴责了该广告。

paras.en: Acton's campaign also released a statement and video from her brother, Philip Stearns, who said the two were removed from their mother's custody. He recalled his older sister taking "the worst" of the abuse they faced as children in order to protect him
paras.zh: 阿克顿的竞选团队还发布了她哥哥菲利普·斯特恩斯的声明和视频，称两人已被解除母亲的监护。他回忆说，他的姐姐为了保护他，承受了童年时所遭受的“最严重”的虐待。

paras.en: "Shame on Vivek. The contempt he has for Amy is the contempt he has for Ohio. He's not fit to lead," said Stearns.
paras.zh: “维韦克感到羞耻。他对艾米的蔑视就是他对俄亥俄州的蔑视。他不适合领导，”斯特恩斯说。

paras.en: The Columbus Dispatch, in an editorial Wednesday morning endorsing Acton for governor for several reasons, called the ad "revolting and unsettling." The newspaper condemned the smear from Republicans while the party continues to support Rep. Max Miller, who is campaigning for re-election after being accused of child and spousal abuse by his ex-wife.
paras.zh: 《哥伦布快报》在周三上午的一篇社论中出于多种原因支持阿克顿担任州长，称这则广告“令人反感且令人不安”。该报谴责了共和党人的诽谤行为，而该党继续支持众议员马克斯·米勒(Max Miller)，他在被前妻指控虐待儿童和配偶后正在竞选连任。

paras.en: According to police and court documents obtained by The Associated Press, Cledith Arthur was arrested and charged with the rape of his stepdaughter, then 12, in July 1978, after Acton's biological father reported him to authorities. The abuse allegedly happened between 1976 and 1978.
paras.zh: 据美联社获得的警方和法庭文件显示，1978 年 7 月，阿克顿的亲生父亲向当局举报克莱迪思·阿瑟 (Cledith Arthur)，之后他被捕并被指控强奸了当时 12 岁的继女。据称，虐待事件发生在 1976 年至 1978 年间。

paras.en: Cledith Arthur pleaded not guilty but was out on bail and fled the state. He died in 2004, never having faced trial in the case.
paras.zh: 克莱迪斯·亚瑟 (Cledith Arthur) 不认罪，但获得保释并逃离该州。他于 2004 年去世，从未接受过此案的审判。

paras.en: High-profile Republicans who back Ramaswamy — including Donald Trump Jr. and influencer Laura Loomer — elevated his video in online posts.
paras.zh: 支持拉马斯瓦米的高调共和党人——包括小唐纳德·特朗普和有影响力的劳拉·卢默——在网上帖子中夸赞了他的视频。

paras.en: - Video Inflation top of mind for voters ahead of U.S. midterms
paras.zh: - 美国中期选举前选民最关心的问题是视频通胀

paras.en: - The Democrats are surging as the U.S. midterms near. Here's the data that has Trump's Republicans spooked
paras.zh: - 随着美国中期选举的临近，民主党的支持率正在飙升。这是令特朗普的共和党人感到害怕的数据

paras.en: But other Republicans joined Democrats in condemning the ad. Pundit Meghan McCain called it "dastardly" and Dan Hauser, a strategist for Republican Sen. Mike Lee of Utah, said he deleted his post sharing the video once he realized "the very serious accusations that caused their issues."
paras.zh: 但其他共和党人与民主党人一起谴责这则广告。专家梅根·麦凯恩称其为“卑鄙”，犹他州共和党参议员迈克·李的策略师丹·豪瑟表示，一旦他意识到“导致他们问题的非常严重的指控”，他就删除了分享该视频的帖子。

paras.en: Casey Putsch, a car designer and YouTube provocateur who competed in the Republican primary earlier this year against Ramaswamy, said on social media that he would be voting for Acton in the wake of the ad's release.
paras.zh: 汽车设计师兼 YouTube 煽动者凯西·普奇 (Casey Putsch) 今年早些时候在共和党初选中与拉马斯瓦米竞争，他在社交媒体上表示，广告发布后他将投票给阿克顿。

paras.en: Putsch — who earlier this year sported a rifle in a campaign ad in which he invited Ramaswamy to play a game of "cowboys and Indians" — called the Arthur video "pretty damn low."
paras.zh: 普奇今年早些时候在一则竞选广告中举起了步枪，邀请拉马斯瓦米玩“牛仔和印第安人”的游戏，他称亚瑟的视频“非常低俗”。

paras.en: JD Vance, who represented Ohio in the Senate before becoming vice-president, said in Cincinnati on Wednesday that "whether the ad was appropriate or not is not really my concern."
paras.zh: 在成为副总统之前曾在参议院代表俄亥俄州的 JD 万斯周三在辛辛那提表示，“这则广告是否合适并不是我所关心的。”

paras.en: Ramaswamy, 41, is a biotech billionaire born to parents from India. He has never before held public office, but ran for president in 2024, dropping out to give Donald Trump his endorsement after finishing fourth in the Iowa caucuses.
paras.zh: 41 岁的拉马斯瓦米是一位生物技术亿万富翁，父母来自印度。他此前从未担任过公职，但在 2024 年竞选总统，在爱荷华州党团会议中获得第四名后退出，转而支持唐纳德·特朗普。

paras.en: Trump tapped Ramaswamy and Elon Musk to lead an effort to root out federal government inefficiencies, but the Cincinnati native stepped down before that DOGE project began in earnest, to concentrate on running for governor.
paras.zh: 特朗普任命拉马斯瓦米和埃隆·马斯克领导一项努力，以消除联邦政府的低效率问题，但这位辛辛那提人在 DOGE 项目正式开始之前就辞职了，专注于竞选州长。

articles.title: Pakistan-Taliban conflict: How India could benefit from shifting regional dynamics

paras.en: Pakistan and Afghanistan right now are locked in a cycle of escalating tension. Repeated border clashes have strained ties between the two nations.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦和阿富汗目前陷入紧张局势升级的循环之中。反复发生的边境冲突导致两国关系紧张。

paras.en: The current round of tensions began in February 2026, when Pakistan launched strikes into Afghanistan targeting Taliban militants. At one point in March, Pakistan's defense minister said the country was at "open war" with Afghanistan. Periodic bouts of violence have continued since then, with the latest Pakistani strikes targeting the Afghan Taliban's "terrorist hubs" reported earlier in October.
paras.zh: 本轮紧张局势始于2026年2月，当时巴基斯坦对阿富汗发动针对塔利班武装分子的袭击。三月份的某个时候，巴基斯坦国防部长表示该国正与阿富汗进行“公开战争”。此后，周期性的暴力事件持续不断，据报道，巴基斯坦十月初针对阿富汗塔利班的“恐怖分子中心”发动了最新的袭击。

paras.en: At the heart of the dispute is Pakistan's accusation that the Taliban authorities in Kabul allow the Tehrik-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), a militant group, to target Pakistan from Afghan territory. Kabul denies providing the group with sanctuary.
paras.zh: 争端的核心是巴基斯坦指责喀布尔塔利班当局允许激进组织巴基斯坦塔利班运动（TTP）从阿富汗领土针对巴基斯坦。喀布尔否认为该组织提供庇护。

paras.en: As the two neighbors trade strikes, the escalating conflict "presents a significant diplomatic and strategic opportunity for India," Shanthie Mariet D'Souza, an Afghanistan expert and founder of the India-based Mantraya Institute for Strategic Studies, told DW.
paras.zh: 阿富汗问题专家、印度曼特拉亚战略研究所创始人尚蒂·玛丽特·德苏扎 (Shanthie Mariet D'Souza) 向德国之声表示，随着这两个邻国的贸易打击，不断升级的冲突“为印度提供了重要的外交和战略机遇”。

paras.en: D'Souza argues the confrontation has weakened Pakistan's traditional influence in Afghanistan and encouraged the Taliban to broaden its external relations.
paras.zh: 迪苏萨认为，这场对抗削弱了巴基斯坦在阿富汗的传统影响力，并鼓励塔利班扩大其对外关系。

paras.en: "India can respond by expanding diplomatic engagement, humanitarian assistance, development projects and trade, while seeking assurances that Afghan territory will not be used by anti-India militant groups," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“印度可以通过扩大外交接触、人道主义援助、发展项目和贸易来做出回应，同时寻求阿富汗领土不会被反印度武装组织利用的保证。”

paras.en: However, D'Souza cautioned against interpreting the opening as a fundamental realignment.
paras.zh: 然而，迪索萨警告不要将这一开放解释为根本性的重组。

paras.en: "There is no ideological alignment between India and the Taliban," she said. Afghanistan under Taliban rule is likely to pursue a diversified foreign policy rather than align exclusively with New Delhi.
paras.zh: “印度和塔利班之间没有意识形态上的一致性，”她说。塔利班统治下的阿富汗可能会奉行多元化的外交政策，而不是只与新德里结盟。

paras.en: India also lacks the geographical advantages, economic leverage and security presence needed to replace Pakistan's influence, she notes. "The scenario of the Taliban becoming a strategic ally remains far-fetched."
paras.zh: 她指出，印度还缺乏取代巴基斯坦影响力所需的地理优势、经济影响力和安全存在。 “塔利班成为战略盟友的设想仍然很牵强。”

paras.en: Former Indian ambassador to Afghanistan Amar Sinha warned against viewing the conflict simply as an opportunity for New Delhi to gain at Pakistan's expense.
paras.zh: 印度前驻阿富汗大使阿马尔·辛哈警告说，不要将这场冲突仅仅视为新德里以牺牲巴基斯坦为代价获取利益的机会。

paras.en: "The issues have very little to do with India," Sinha told DW, arguing that India was not seeking strategic advantage from the fighting. He also pointed to the consequences of Pakistan's military actions for Afghan civilians.
paras.zh: 辛哈对德国之声表示：“这些问题与印度没有什么关系。”他认为印度并没有从战斗中寻求战略优势。他还指出了巴基斯坦军事行动对阿富汗平民造成的后果。

paras.en: "Yet the rupture has made Kabul's search for alternative partners more pressing," he added.
paras.zh: “然而，分裂使得喀布尔寻找替代合作伙伴变得更加紧迫，”他补充道。

paras.en: For India, that creates an opening, but not necessarily a strategic alignment, Sinha notes. The Taliban can seek Indian assistance while maintaining relations with China, Russia, Iran and Gulf states, preserving its autonomy rather than exchanging dependence on Pakistan for dependence on India.
paras.zh: 辛哈指出，对印度来说，这创造了一个机会，但不一定是战略联盟。塔利班可以寻求印度的援助，同时维持与中国、俄罗斯、伊朗和海湾国家的关系，保留其自主权，而不是通过对巴基斯坦的依赖转而对印度的依赖。

paras.en: Gautam Mukhopadhyaya, another former Indian ambassador to Afghanistan, sees the deterioration in relations between Pakistan and the Taliban as an opportunity for India to recover some of the strategic ground it lost when the Taliban returned to power in 2021.
paras.zh: 另一位前印度驻阿富汗大使高塔姆·穆霍帕迪亚亚 (Gautam Mukhopadhyaya) 认为，巴基斯坦与塔利班关系恶化是印度收复 2021 年塔利班重新掌权时失去的部分战略阵地的机会。

paras.en: "The crisis has allowed strategic openings for India," Mukhopadhyaya told DW. He warned, however, that New Delhi's own treatment of Afghans could undermine its efforts to build a durable relationship.
paras.zh: 穆霍帕迪亚亚告诉德国之声：“这场危机为印度提供了战略机会。”但他警告说，新德里对待阿富汗人的方式可能会破坏其建立持久关系的努力。

paras.en: He pointed to restrictions affecting Afghans seeking Indian visas for education, scholarships, work and medical treatment.
paras.zh: 他指出，阿富汗人寻求印度教育、奖学金、工作和医疗签证受到的限制。

paras.en: "For all practical purposes, India's security establishment treats Afghans as proxy Pakistanis and 'terrorists' by default," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“出于所有实际目的，印度安全机构默认将阿富汗人视为巴基斯坦代理人和‘恐怖分子’。”

paras.en: Former Afghan partners had been left "disappointed, even bitter," Mukhopadhyaya added. "A strategic relationship built on the sands of oppression is not a sound foundation."
paras.zh: 穆霍帕迪亚亚补充说，前阿富汗合作伙伴感到“失望，甚至痛苦”。 “建立在压迫之上的战略关系并不是一个坚实的基础。”

paras.en: India has restored air freight links between Kabul and Delhi and between Kabul and Amritsar in northwestern India in December 2025.
paras.zh: 印度已于 2025 年 12 月恢复喀布尔和德里之间以及印度西北部喀布尔和阿姆利则之间的空运联系。

paras.en: Bilateral trade between India and Afghanistan stood at about $908 million (€807 million) in the 2025-26 fiscal year, while trade between Pakistan and Afghanistan fell sharply amid repeated border closures.
paras.zh: 2025-26财年，印度和阿富汗之间的双边贸易额约为9.08亿美元（8.07亿欧元），而巴基斯坦和阿富汗之间的贸易额则因边境多次关闭而大幅下降。

paras.en: On October 14, Taliban Foreign Minister Amir Khan Muttaqi stressed the importance of relations with India during talks with Indian charge d'affaires Yatin Patel, signaling Kabul's interest in expanding economic cooperation.
paras.zh: 10月14日，塔利班外长穆塔吉在与印度临时代办帕特尔会谈时强调了与印度关系的重要性，表明喀布尔有兴趣扩大经济合作。

paras.en: But air freight is expensive, and India cannot easily replace Pakistan as a transit route.
paras.zh: 但空运价格昂贵，印度无法轻易取代巴基斯坦作为过境航线。

paras.en: New Delhi has sought to use Iran's Chabahar port to improve access to Afghanistan and Central Asia, but regional instability and complications surrounding Iran have constrained those ambitions.
paras.zh: 新德里试图利用伊朗的恰巴哈尔港来改善通往阿富汗和中亚的通道，但地区不稳定和围绕伊朗的复杂情况限制了这一雄心。

paras.en: D'Souza cautioned that "the ongoing conflict in Iran" limits India's ability to use Chabahar as a crucial trade and connectivity hub.
paras.zh: 迪索萨警告说，“伊朗持续的冲突”限制了印度利用恰巴哈尔作为重要贸易和互联互通枢纽的能力。

paras.en: Gulshan Sachdeva, a professor at Jawaharlal Nehru University specializing in Afghanistan and Eurasian connectivity, highlighted similar obstacles.
paras.zh: 贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁大学专门研究阿富汗和欧亚互联互通的教授古尔尚·萨赫德瓦（Gulshan Sachdeva）强调了类似的障碍。

paras.en: "In the last few decades, Islamabad has obstructed Kabul's efforts to gain access to the vast Indian market. However, political instability in Afghanistan and sanctions on Iran have undermined these efforts," Sachdeva told DW.
paras.zh: 萨赫德瓦告诉德国之声：“过去几十年来，伊斯兰堡阻碍了喀布尔进入广阔的印度市场的努力。然而，阿富汗的政治不稳定和对伊朗的制裁破坏了这些努力。”

paras.en: "Afghanistan's potential as a connector between regional markets remains considerable, but the infrastructure and political conditions needed to realize it are far from assured," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“阿富汗作为区域市场之间连接器的潜力仍然巨大，但实现这一潜力所需的基础设施和政治条件还远未确定。”

paras.en: Sachdeva also sees Russia and China as better positioned to shape Afghanistan's wider economic integration. Alternative routes may become more attractive to India, but they are not commercially viable overnight.
paras.zh: 萨赫德瓦还认为俄罗斯和中国更有能力塑造阿富汗更广泛的经济一体化。替代路线可能对印度更具吸引力，但它们在商业上并不可行。

paras.en: Pakistan has portrayed arch-rival India's growing engagement with the Taliban as a security threat. On October 7, Pakistani diplomat Muhammad Jawad Ajmal accused India at the United Nations of providing the Taliban with material and logistical support.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦将其主要竞争对手印度与塔利班日益密切的接触视为一种安全威胁。 10月7日，巴基斯坦外交官穆罕默德·贾瓦德·阿杰迈勒在联合国指责印度向塔利班提供物资和后勤支持。

paras.en: "Under the guise of humanitarian aid, they have been actively supporting the Taliban regime with material and logistical support for carrying out terrorist attacks against Pakistan," Ajmal said.
paras.zh: 阿杰迈勒说：“他们打着人道主义援助的幌子，积极为塔利班政权提供物质和后勤支持，以对巴基斯坦实施恐怖袭击。”

paras.en: The allegation reflects Islamabad's position and has not been established as fact.
paras.zh: 该指控反映了伊斯兰堡的立场，但尚未被证实为事实。

paras.en: Pakistan has accused India of supporting the TTP and the Balochistan Liberation Army, a militant organization.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦指责印度支持TTP和激进组织俾路支解放军。

paras.en: India rejects accusations of backing militant activity, while the Taliban denies allowing Afghan territory to be used for attacks against Pakistan.
paras.zh: 印度否认支持武装活动的指控，而塔利班则否认允许阿富汗领土被用来袭击巴基斯坦。

paras.en: Ayesha Siddiqa, a Pakistani expert on military and security affairs at King's College London, offered a more nuanced assessment of Pakistan's position.
paras.zh: 伦敦国王学院巴基斯坦军事和安全事务专家阿耶莎·西迪卡对巴基斯坦的立场提出了更为细致的评估。

paras.en: "India has stepped into a space and is trying to exert its influence and feed anti-Pakistan groups intelligence," she told DW.
paras.zh: 她告诉德国之声：“印度已经进入了一个领域，并试图发挥其影响力并为反巴基斯坦组织提供情报。”

paras.en: Siddiqa added that Pakistan's establishment continues to view the crisis through "a singular security lens."
paras.zh: 西迪卡补充说，巴基斯坦当权者继续通过“单一的安全视角”来看待这场危机。

paras.en: "Islamabad feels physically squeezed from both sides," she said, adding that closer Kabul-New Delhi ties could create "a dangerous two-front security trap" for Pakistan.
paras.zh: 她说：“伊斯兰堡感觉受到了双方的挤压。”她补充说，喀布尔与新德里之间更紧密的关系可能会给巴基斯坦造成“危险的两条战线安全陷阱”。

paras.en: India may gain more room to operate in Afghanistan as ties between Kabul and Islamabad deteriorate. But the Taliban is unlikely to put all its eggs in New Delhi's basket.
paras.zh: 随着喀布尔和伊斯兰堡之间的关系恶化，印度可能会在阿富汗获得更多的活动空间。但塔利班不太可能把所有鸡蛋都放在新德里的篮子里。

articles.title: Russia frees jailed American Stephen Hubbard during Witkoff talks

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin announced the release of US captive Stephen Hubbard during talks with US special envoy Steve Witkoff in St. Petersburg on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京周三在圣彼得堡与美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫会谈时宣布释放美国俘虏斯蒂芬·哈伯德。

paras.en: Hubbard had been taken captive by Russian forces on charges of being a mercenary, which he denies. He was sentenced to seven years in prison at a closed trial in 2024.
paras.zh: 哈伯德因被指控为雇佣兵而被俄罗斯军队俘虏，但他否认了这一点。 2024 年，他在一次非公开审判中被判处七年监禁。

paras.en: Putin said Hubbard was at the airport and Witkoff said he was now "going home to his family."
paras.zh: 普京说哈伯德在机场，维特科夫说他现在“回家与家人团聚”。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump later said he had made the request directly to Putin during a phone call last week.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普后来表示，他在上周的电话中直接向普京提出了这一要求。

paras.en: "The United States, out of respect for President Trump, was not required to give anything in return — an unprecedented situation for Russia," Trump claimed in a post on his Truth Social platform. "There was no 'swap' necessary for this release."
paras.zh: 特朗普在其“真相社交”平台上发帖称，“出于对特朗普总统的尊重，美国不需要给予任何回报——这对俄罗斯来说是前所未有的情况。” “这次发布不需要‘交换’。”

paras.en: However, in a follow-up post, Trump also claimed that "numerous people" had called him to apologize after they criticized him for suspending a new round of sanctions, which he said was a necessary concession.
paras.zh: 不过，特朗普在后续帖子中还声称，“很多人”在批评他暂停新一轮制裁后给他打电话道歉，他称这是必要的让步。

paras.en: "If sanctions would have been placed, certainly those negotiations would have come to a complete and total halt," Trump's post said.
paras.zh: 特朗普的帖子称：“如果实施制裁，这些谈判肯定会完全停止。”

paras.en: Russia agrees to trilateral talks with Ukraine, US
paras.zh: 俄罗斯同意与乌克兰和美国举行三边会谈

paras.en: The release of Hubbard was seen as a goodwill gesture to the Trump administration as the two sides discuss a deal for peace between Russia and Ukraine.
paras.zh: 在双方讨论俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的和平协议之际，哈伯德的释放被视为对特朗普政府的善意姿态。

paras.en: "We've brought some papers. It's really some ideas, some sort of peace deal between Russia and Ukraine, and you'll read that at your leisure," Witkoff told Putin.
paras.zh: “我们带来了一些文件。这实际上是一些想法，俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的某种和平协议，你可以在闲暇时阅读，”维特科夫告诉普京。

paras.en: After the talks, the Kremlin said Witkoff's proposals "lacked substance" and would not be of real use for a potential peace settlement.
paras.zh: 会谈结束后，克里姆林宫表示，维特科夫的提议“缺乏实质内容”，对潜在的和平解决方案没有真正的用处。

paras.en: However, Putin agreed "in principle" to resume peace talks with Russian, Ukrainian and US delegates after November 10.
paras.zh: 不过，普京“原则上”同意在11月10日之后与俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国代表恢复和谈。

paras.en: Such talks should focus on "building a security system for Russia and Ukraine after the conflict ends," Putin's foreign affairs adviser Yuri Ushakov said.
paras.zh: 普京的外交事务顾问尤里·乌沙科夫表示，此类会谈的重点应该是“在冲突结束后为俄罗斯和乌克兰建立安全体系”。

paras.en: Putin also proposed that Witkoff discuss the restoration of bilateral ties between Washington and Moscow.
paras.zh: 普京还提议维特科夫讨论恢复华盛顿和莫斯科之间的双边关系。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Putin appeared open to a potential trilateral meeting with Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing.
paras.zh: 与此同时，普京似乎对与特朗普和中国国家主席习近平在北京举行的潜在三边会议持开放态度。

paras.en: "A possible first-ever meeting of the leaders of China, Russia and the United States... is being prepared," Ushakov said.
paras.zh: 乌沙科夫说：“中国、俄罗斯和美国领导人可能举行的首次会晤……正在筹备中。”

paras.en: The meeting — the ninth such talks between Witkoff and Putin — came a day after Witkoff met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Norway.
paras.zh: 这次会议是威特科夫和普京之间的第九次此类会谈，一天前威特科夫在挪威会见了乌克兰总统泽连斯基。

paras.en: European leaders hope for productive negotiations
paras.zh: 欧洲领导人希望谈判富有成果

paras.en: Zelenskyy on Wednesday called for freezing the front line as a first step toward ceasefire talks.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周三呼吁冻结前线，作为停火谈判的第一步。

paras.en: "Right now we have to freeze, and I think this is (the) real way to end this war. We call it ceasefire... freeze and stop," Zelenskyy said in an interview with "Fox & Friends."
paras.zh: “现在我们必须冻结，我认为这是结束这场战争的真正方法。我们称之为停火……冻结并停止，”泽伦斯基在接受“福克斯与朋友”采访时说。

paras.en: The European Union, which was represented by delegates from several member states at the Oslo talks on Tuesday, said it expected to be debriefed by Washington after Wednesday's talks.
paras.zh: 周二由多个成员国代表出席奥斯陆会谈的欧盟表示，预计华盛顿将在周三会谈后听取情况汇报。

paras.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz also said on Wednesday that Berlin was supporting Ukraine to end the war as quickly as possible, adding that any capitulation by Ukraine would be "a capitulation by all of us."
paras.zh: 德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨周三也表示，柏林支持乌克兰尽快结束战争，并补充说，乌克兰的任何投降都将是“我们所有人的投降”。

paras.en: The Ukrainian leader remained in Oslo on Wednesday where met with lawmakers in the Norwegian parliament.
paras.zh: 乌克兰领导人周三仍留在奥斯陆，会见了挪威议会的议员。

paras.en: Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store said that Witkoff planned to return to Oslo for further consultations after his trip to St. Petersburg.
paras.zh: 挪威首相乔纳斯·加尔斯托表示，威特科夫计划在圣彼得堡之行后返回奥斯陆进行进一步磋商。

paras.en: "I think we may have entered a phase now where the Russians are also looking for opportunities for diplomacy," he told Norway's public broadcaster NRK on Wednesday morning.
paras.zh: 周三上午，他对挪威公共广播公司 NRK 表示：“我认为我们现在可能已经进入了俄罗斯也在寻找外交机会的阶段。”

articles.title: Russia arrests German man, calls him a Ukraine 'mercenary'

paras.en: Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB) domestic intelligence agency said on Wednesday that it had arrested a German national on allegations of mercenary activity, calling him an "active member of the Ukrainian armed forces."
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局（FSB）国内情报机构周三表示，已因涉嫌雇佣军活动逮捕了一名德国国民，称他是“乌克兰武装部队的活跃成员”。

paras.en: The news came on the same day that Russia released a retired teacher from the US, Stephen Hubbard, after years in detention on similar mercenary charges, which he denied.
paras.zh: 这一消息发布的同一天，俄罗斯释放了美国退休教师斯蒂芬·哈伯德(Stephen Hubbard)，他因类似的雇佣军指控被​​拘留多年，但他否认了这一指控。

paras.en: Russia has detained a number of foreign nationals since its 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine, accusing them of assisting Kyiv in some way or another.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年全面入侵乌克兰以来，俄罗斯已拘留了多名外国人，指控他们以某种方式协助基辅。

paras.en: There was no immediate comment from Germany's government, besides acknowledging that it had seen the reports and was pursuing them.
paras.zh: 德国政府没有立即发表评论，只是承认已看到这些报告并正在追查这些报告。

paras.en: The FSB said in a statement carried widely by Russian media that the man was a former Bundeswehr soldier and trained sniper. It did not issue his name but published a short video in which he could be heard speaking German.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局在一份被俄罗斯媒体广泛转载的声明中表示，该男子是一名前联邦国防军士兵，也是受过训练的狙击手。它没有公布他的名字，但发布了一段简短的视频，可以听到他说德语。

paras.en: According to the FSB, the man was a Bundeswehr soldier from 1996 to 2010, who served in Afghanistan and Somalia between 2004 and 2010.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯联邦安全局称，该男子于1996年至2010年期间是一名德国联邦国防军士兵，2004年至2010年期间曾在阿富汗和索马里服役。

paras.en: They alleged that he later operated as a mercenary fighter in Syria's civil war.
paras.zh: 他们声称他后来在叙利亚内战中担任雇佣兵。

paras.en: From 2016 to 2018, according to the Russian spy agency, he fought in Ukraine against the Russian-backed rebels in eastern states, prior to Moscow's full-scale invasion in 2022.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯间谍机构称，2016年至2018年，他在乌克兰东部各州与俄罗斯支持的叛乱分子作战，随后莫斯科于2022年全面入侵。

paras.en: The FSB claimed that he returned to Ukraine as a "mercenary" in 2025 and was fighting in the contested region of Donetsk, but then deserted over non-payment of wages.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局声称，他于2025年以“雇佣兵”身份返回乌克兰，并在有争议的顿涅茨克地区作战，但随后因拖欠工资而开小差。

paras.en: They did not comment on why or how the man, whom they said was born in 1976, had come to be in Russia. Nor did they say where or under what circumstances they arrested him.
paras.zh: 他们没有评论这个出生于 1976 年的男子为什么或如何来到俄罗斯。他们也没有透露在哪里或在什么情况下逮捕了他。

paras.en: A spokesperson at the German Foreign Ministry only initially responded by saying that Berlin was aware of the reports from Russia.
paras.zh: 德国外交部发言人最初回应称柏林了解俄罗斯的报道。

paras.en: The spokesperson said the ministry would not comment on the individual case or specifics for the time being.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示，该部暂时不会对个案或具体细节发表评论。

paras.en: Similar Swedish arrest last week, US prisoner freed
paras.zh: 瑞典上周类似逮捕，美国囚犯获释

paras.en: Russia has arrested hundreds of foreign nationals on charges like espionage, sabotage and treason amid its invasion of neighboring Ukraine. The charges can carry lengthy prison sentences.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯在入侵邻国乌克兰期间以间谍、破坏和叛国罪等罪名逮捕了数百名外国人。这些指控可能会导致长期监禁。

paras.en: A smaller number have also been accused of mercenary activity.
paras.zh: 少数人还被指控从事雇佣军活动。

paras.en: The FSB last week arrested a Swedish national, again accusing him of fighting on Kyiv's behalf.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局上周逮捕了一名瑞典国民，再次指控他为基辅而战。

paras.en: In his case, they said he was operating as the commander of a drone unit and that he was detained attempting to illegally cross the border in the western Pskov region.
paras.zh: 在他的案件中，他们说他是一支无人机部队的指挥官，他因试图非法越过普斯科夫西部地区的边境而被拘留。

paras.en: A Japanese journalist was also arrested last week, accused of espionage, prompting sharp criticism from Tokyo.
paras.zh: 一名日本记者上周也因间谍罪被捕，引发东京方面的严厉批评。

paras.en: Also on Wednesday, Russia released a retired US teacher, Stephen Hubbard, who had been arrested in 2024 on comparable allegations.
paras.zh: 同样在周三，俄罗斯释放了美国退休教师斯蒂芬·哈伯德 (Stephen Hubbard)，他曾因类似指控于 2024 年被捕。

paras.en: This took place as US negotiator Steve Witkoff was visiting St. Petersburg and after a series of recent concessions to Russia and criticisms of Ukraine from US President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 此事发生之际，美国谈判代表史蒂夫·威特科夫正在访问圣彼得堡，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普最近对俄罗斯做出了一系列让步，并对乌克兰提出了批评。

paras.en: Trump claimed there was no quid pro quo involved in the release, but later said Hubbard would not be free if he had not eased sanctions on Russian diesel shipments.
paras.zh: 特朗普声称此次释放不涉及任何交换条件，但后来表示，如果哈伯德不放松对俄罗斯柴油运输的制裁，他就不会获得自由。
