paras.zh: NPR 文字记录的准确性和可用性可能有所不同。转录文本可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。 npr.org 上的音频可能会在其原始广播或发布后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: DOJ's noncitizen voter list is unreliable, officials say. And, U.S. pollution rises
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: DOJ's noncitizen voter list is unreliable, officials say. And, U.S. pollution rises
paras.zh: 官员们表示，司法部的非公民选民名单不可靠。而且，美国的污染加剧

paras.en: Los Angeles County election officials say that the Justice Department's list of 20,000 "likely" noncitizens registered to vote is "unreliable," based on their preliminary analysis. They also say some of the individuals on the list have indicated they were born in the U.S. and may be citizens. State and local officials disclosed these new details in court filings yesterday, in response to a federal lawsuit demanding that California investigate thousands of voters before their ballots are counted. The DOJ wants the state to segregate ballots associated with these individuals. California officials say the DOJ's request is unfeasible so close to the election and may violate federal and state election laws.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶县选举官员表示，根据初步分析，司法部列出的 20,000 名“可能”登记投票的非公民名单“不可靠”。他们还表示，名单上的一些人已表明他们出生在美国，可能是美国公民。州和地方官员昨天在法庭文件中披露了这些新细节，以回应一项联邦诉讼，该诉讼要求加州在计票前对数千名选民进行调查。司法部希望该州将与这些人相关的选票分开。加州官员表示，司法部的要求在如此接近选举的情况下是不可行的，并且可能违反联邦和州选举法。

paras.en: A new report from United Nations scientists says that countries are not doing enough to cut emissions that drive climate change, and the United States plays a significant role in climate pollution. The U.S. was the only major economy that saw an increase last year in planet-warming pollution. The report also found that, among G20 countries, the U.S. is tied with Russia for the highest per capita emissions. While China emits more total greenhouse gases annually than the U.S., China's population is more than four times that of the U.S. The rise in U.S. emissions was fueled by increased electricity demand and Trump administration policies that support burning fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 联合国科学家的一份新报告称，各国在减少导致气候变化的排放方面做得不够，而美国在气候污染方面发挥着重要作用。美国是去年导致全球变暖的污染增加的唯一主要经济体。报告还发现，在G20国家中，美国与俄罗斯的人均排放量并列第一。虽然中国每年排放的温室气体总量比美国多，但中国的人口是美国的四倍多。电力需求的增加和特朗普政府支持燃烧化石燃料的政策推动了美国排放量的增加。

paras.en: Arrests for low-level crimes, including vagrancy and drug possession, increased in the U.S. from 2024 to 2025, according to a new analysis of federal data from the criminal justice and immigration reforms advocacy group FWD.us. The report also highlighted a 188% increase in immigration violations. This comes as violent crime rates, including homicides, dropped to historic lows. The report examined publicly available FBI and immigration arrest data and does not include details about whether charges were dropped or if people served any time in jail or prison. This data covers the first full year of Trump's second term, during which his administration emphasized a tough-on-crime approach. Zoë Towns, the executive director of FWD.us, told NPR ahead of the report's release that the rising trends signal a "really troubling return to some of the extreme law and order policies that defined the American criminal justice system during the '80s and '90s." Check out NPR's analysis.
paras.zh: 根据刑事司法和移民改革倡导组织 FWD.us 对联邦数据的最新分析，从 2024 年到 2025 年，美国因流浪和持有毒品等低级犯罪而被捕的人数有所增加。该报告还强调，移民违法行为增加了 188%。与此同时，包括凶杀在内的暴力犯罪率降至历史低点。该报告审查了公开的联邦调查局和移民逮捕数据，但没有包括有关指控是否被撤销或人员是否在监狱服刑的详细信息。这些数据涵盖特朗普第二任期的第一年，在此期间他的政府强调严厉打击犯罪。 FWD.us 执行董事佐伊·汤斯 (Zoë Towns) 在报告发布前向 NPR 表示，这种上升趋势表明“确实令人不安的是，一些在 80 年代和 90 年代定义美国刑事司法系统的极端法律和秩序政策正在回归”。看看 NPR 的分析。

paras.en: President Trump's envoy Steve Witkoff is in St. Petersburg today to meet with Kremlin officials and explore potential solutions for ending Russia's war on Ukraine. Witkoff also met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy this week in Norway. Trump has accused Zelenskyy of obstructing a peace deal. The Ukrainian president says he is again seeking direct talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统的特使史蒂夫·威特科夫今天在圣彼得堡会见克里姆林宫官员，并探讨结束俄罗斯对乌克兰战争的潜在解决方案。维特科夫本周还在挪威会见了乌克兰总统泽连斯基。特朗普指责泽伦斯基阻碍和平协议。乌克兰总统表示，他再次寻求与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行直接会谈。

paras.en: - 🎧 Norway and Finland's leaders believe a fair deal to end the war requires U.S. involvement, NPR's Joanna Kakissis tells Up First. They hope Witkoff's Russia leads to something constructive. But Ukrainians whom Kakissis has spoken to say they don't trust the White House and believe the U.S. is siding with Russia. Concerns grew among Ukrainians when President Trump announced he would lift sanctions on Russian diesel. Many argued that the move wouldn't lower fuel prices but instead help Russia continue its war against Ukraine.
paras.zh: - 🎧 挪威和芬兰领导人认为，结束战争的公平协议需要美国的参与，NPR 的乔安娜·卡基西斯 (Joanna Kakissis) 告诉 Up First。他们希望威特科夫的俄罗斯能够带来一些建设性的成果。但与卡基西斯交谈过的乌克兰人表示，他们不信任白宫，并认为美国站在俄罗斯一边。当特朗普总统宣布取消对俄罗斯柴油的制裁时，乌克兰人的担忧加剧。许多人认为，此举不会降低燃油价格，反而会帮助俄罗斯继续对乌克兰发动战争。

paras.en: The results of the 2026 midterm elections will shape the final two years of President Trump's second term and serve as a precursor to the 2028 general election. This month, Morning Edition is reporting from six states that could change the balance of power in Washington.
paras.zh: 2026年中期选举的结果将决定特朗普总统第二任期的最后两年，并成为2028年大选的前兆。本月，《晨报》报道了六个可能改变华盛顿权力平衡的州。

paras.en: This week, Morning Edition's Steve Inskeep traveled to North Carolina and Georgia. Both states are among those Trump visited this week as he continues to campaign for Republicans vying to keep control of the Senate and House. Inskeep explored how the Trump administration's policies have affected public research in both states. Trump has eliminated hundreds of jobs from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, which is headquartered in Atlanta. Universities and research firms in North Carolina's Research Triangle lost millions of dollars in federal grants last year. Inskeep spoke with people affected by these changes. Listen to what they had to say.
paras.zh: 本周，《晨报》的史蒂夫·英斯基普前往北卡罗来纳州和佐治亚州。这两个州都是特朗普本周访问的州之一，他继续为共和党竞选，争夺参议院和众议院的控制权。英斯基普探讨了特朗普政府的政策如何影响这两个州的公共研究。特朗普已经裁掉了总部位于亚特兰大的疾病控制与预防中心的数百个工作岗位。北卡罗来纳州研究三角区的大学和研究公司去年损失了数百万美元的联邦拨款。因斯基普与受这些变化影响的人们进行了交谈。听听他们怎么说。

paras.en: - 🎧 Inskeep got personal thoughts from random Georgia voters by knocking on some doors and meeting people along walking trails.
paras.zh: - 🎧 因斯基普通过敲门并沿着步行道与人们会面，从随机的佐治亚州选民那里获得了个人想法。

paras.en: - 🎧 In North Carolina, he visited communities devastated by Hurricane Helene in 2024 to assess changes two years after the federal response became a campaign issue.
paras.zh: - 🎧 在北卡罗来纳州，他访问了 2024 年被飓风海伦摧毁的社区，以评估联邦政府的应对措施成为竞选议题两年后的变化。

paras.en: - 🎧 In Stokes County, N.C., Inskeep explores how AI data centers have divided the community. In 2024, 79% of voters in the county backed Trump. The president has supported these centers.
paras.zh: - 🎧 在北卡罗来纳州斯托克斯县，Inskeep 探讨了人工智能数据中心如何划分社区。 2024年，该县79%的选民支持特朗普。总统支持这些中心。

paras.en: The NPR App has all of NPR's election coverage in one place — from the biggest stories across the country, to the issues that matter close to home. Browse headlines, playlists, podcast episodes, videos and more, all on the 2026 Election tab.
paras.zh: NPR 应用程序将 NPR 的所有选举报道集中于一处 — 从全国最大的新闻到与家庭息息相关的问题。浏览头条新闻、播放列表、播客剧集、视频等，所有这些都在 2026 年选举选项卡上。

paras.en: To cover a transformation as vast as AI, one that raises deep questions about work, culture, the environment, cybersecurity, education and so much more, we've teamed up with veteran tech journalists Casey Newton and Kevin Roose to bring their flagship AI podcast, Machine Gods, to NPR's audiences. Starting today, the video-first program will be offered twice a week across NPR's platforms and provide front-row access to the people and issues shaping this new AI era.
paras.zh: 为了报道人工智能这样巨大的变革，这一变革引发了有关工作、文化、环境、网络安全、教育等方面的深刻问题，我们与资深科技记者凯西·牛顿 (Casey Newton) 和凯文·罗斯 (Kevin Roose) 合作，向 NPR 的观众带来了他们的旗舰人工智能播客《机器之神》。从今天开始，视频优先的节目将在 NPR 的平台上每周播出两次，并为塑造这个新人工智能时代的人们和问题提供前排报道。

paras.en: The show will look into things like the ways AI could be applied to the medical field, potentially helping us discover new drugs and improve healthcare overall, as well as the questions that keep Casey and Kevin both up at night, like what happens when AI eventually builds and improves upon itself beyond what humans understand. With each episode, we'll make sure you get the news you need to know about AI — both the technology's capabilities and its very real risks — without buying into the industry's hype or treating catastrophe as an inevitability.
paras.zh: 该节目将探讨人工智能如何应用于医疗领域，有可能帮助我们发现新药并改善整体医疗保健，以及让凯西和凯文彻夜难眠的问题，比如当人工智能最终构建和改进超出人类理解范围时会发生什么。在每一集中，我们将确保您获得您需要了解的有关人工智能的新闻 - 包括技术的功能及其非常真实的风险 - 而不是相信行业的炒作或将灾难视为不可避免。

paras.en: Machine Gods is the culmination of years of Casey and Kevin's reporting from the front lines of Silicon Valley. While it represents an ambitious new format for public media, its core ethos fits seamlessly with NPR's mission: to bring audiences trusted, independent journalism that inspires, engages, and keeps you informed so you can navigate the world with confidence.
paras.zh: 《机器之神》是凯西和凯文多年来在硅谷前线报道的巅峰之作。虽然它代表了一种雄心勃勃的公共媒体新形式，但其核心精神与 NPR 的使命无缝契合：为受众带来值得信赖的独立新闻报道，激励、吸引并让您了解情况，以便您能够自信地驾驭世界。

paras.en: - Actress Christina Applegate has revealed that she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis five years ago.
paras.zh: - 女演员克里斯蒂娜·艾伯盖特透露，五年前她被误诊为多发性硬化症。

paras.en: - The World Health Organization's new special envoy for health resilience, Dr. Vanessa Kerry, says building more-responsive healthcare systems is what her new job is all about.
paras.zh: - 世界卫生组织新任健康复原力特使凡妮莎·克里博士表示，她的新工作的重点是建立反应更快的医疗保健系统。

paras.en: - Utah is suing Kalshi, alleging that its yes/no event contracts resemble traditional sportsbook bets. The state says the prediction market website is operating illegally due to Utah's constitutional ban on gambling. (via KUER)
paras.zh: - 犹他州正在起诉卡尔希，声称其是/否赛事合同类似于传统的体育博彩投注。该州表示，由于犹他州宪法禁止赌博，该预测市场网站非法运营。 （来自库尔）

articles.title: Israel detains dozens of Americans, including a congressional candidate, in West Bank
articles.author: Ruth Sherlock

paras.en: Israel detains dozens of Americans, including a congressional candidate, in West Bank
paras.zh: 以色列在约旦河西岸拘留了数十名美国人，其中包括一名国会候选人

paras.en: NAHALIN, West Bank — U.S. Democratic congressional nominee Brad Lander was detained along with about 80 American and Israeli rabbis and activists detained by Israeli security forces as they helped Palestinians harvest olives from their grove close to a settlement in the occupied West Bank.
paras.zh: 约旦河西岸纳哈林——美国民主党国会候选人布拉德·兰德 (Brad Lander) 与约 80 名美国和以色列拉比和活动人士一起被以色列安全部队拘留，当时他们正在帮助巴勒斯坦人从被占领的约旦河西岸定居点附近的小树林里收获橄榄。

paras.en: Lander, the former New York City comptroller, later said on social media he has been released from Israeli military custody — he presumed because of his "public profile" — but several dozen others are still detained.
paras.zh: 前纽约市审计长兰德后来在社交媒体上表示，他已从以色列军方拘留中获释——他推测是因为他的“公众形象”——但仍有数十人被拘留。

paras.en: This is the largest mass detention of activists in the occupied West Bank in at least a decade, two Israeli lawyers who work on related cases told NPR. Rabbi Arik Ascherman, a longtime Israeli human rights proponent, called the detentions "unprecedented." This comes amid a spike in violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinian farmers in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 两名处理相关案件的以色列律师告诉美国公共广播电台，这是至少十年来在被占领的西岸对活动人士最大规模的拘留。长期以色列人权支持者拉比阿里克·阿舍曼 (Rabbi Arik Ascherman) 称这次拘留“史无前例”。在此背景下，以色列定居者针对约旦河西岸巴勒斯坦农民的暴力行为激增。

paras.en: The Israeli military said in a statement that harvesting in the area requires the farmers to submit requests to the authorities before the olive harvest season in order to coordinate "security of the area and maintain public order." The military said Palestinians in this area did not submit a request, so soldiers and police arrived and detained those present.
paras.zh: 以色列军方在一份声明中表示，该地区的收割工作要求农民在橄榄收获季节之前向当局提交请求，以协调“该地区的安全并维护公共秩序”。军方表示，该地区的巴勒斯坦人没有提出请求，因此士兵和警察赶到并拘留了在场人员。

paras.en: "Regarding reports of the detention of a congressional candidate, we note that he was released once the matter was brought to our attention," the Israeli military told NPR.
paras.zh: 以色列军方告诉美国国家公共广播电台：“关于一名国会候选人被拘留的报道，我们注意到，此事引起我们注意后，他就被释放了。”

paras.en: "We've been detained by the Israeli military for harvesting olives, and let's be clear: Occupation is a crime under international law," Lander said in a video he filmed from the bus the group was loaded onto to be taken to a police station. "Harvesting olives is not a crime under any law."
paras.zh: “我们因采摘橄榄而被以色列军方拘留，让我们明确一点：根据国际法，占领是一种犯罪行为，”兰德在一段视频中说，他在这群人被带到警察局的巴士上拍摄了视频。 “根据任何法律，收获橄榄都不构成犯罪。”

paras.en: American rabbis from the U.S. organization T'ruah, the Israeli group Rabbis for Human Rights and other activists had joined Palestinian families in picking olives at their grove in Nahalin, close to the Israeli settlement of Beitar Illit. They said they were participating in what they called Protect the Harvest, bringing an international coalition of volunteers together to accompany Palestinian harvesters at a time when they and their farms and other property have come under attack from Israeli settlers in the area.
paras.zh: 来自美国组织 T'ruah 的美国拉比、以色列拉比人权组织和其他活动人士与巴勒斯坦家庭一起，在靠近以色列贝塔伊利特定居点的纳哈林 (Nahalin) 的小树林里采摘橄榄。他们说，他们正在参加所谓的“保护收成”活动，召集一个国际志愿者联盟，在巴勒斯坦收割者及其农场和其他财产受到该地区以色列定居者的攻击时，陪伴他们。

paras.en: Olive harvesting is an important time for Palestinians both culturally and economically. But it has become increasingly hard for Palestinians in the occupied West Bank to access their fields. Several Palestinians there told NPR they have been unable to harvest their olive trees there since the Hamas-led attack on Israel on Oct. 7, 2023, saying it had become too dangerous in the face of rising settler attacks in the occupied West Bank.
paras.zh: 橄榄收获对巴勒斯坦人的文化和经济来说都是一个重要的时刻。但被占领的约旦河西岸的巴勒斯坦人进入他们的田地变得越来越困难。那里的几名巴勒斯坦人告诉 NPR，自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的对以色列的袭击以来，他们一直无法在那里收获橄榄树，并表示，面对被占领的约旦河西岸定居者袭击事件的增加，这里变得太危险了。

paras.en: The detentions come less than a week after American photojournalist Heidi Levine, working for The Washington Post was assaulted by Israeli settlers in the West Bank, the latest journalist to come under attack during the Palestinian olive harvest season. Democratic congressman Ro Khanna of California was also briefly detained by Israeli forces while visiting the West Bank in July.
paras.zh: 不到一周前，为《华盛顿邮报》工作的美国摄影记者海蒂·莱文(Heidi Levine)在约旦河西岸遭到以色列定居者的袭击，这是最新一位在巴勒斯坦橄榄收获季节遭到袭击的记者。加利福尼亚州民主党议员罗·卡纳 (Ro Khanna) 在 7 月访问约旦河西岸时也被以色列军队短暂拘留。

paras.en: On Wednesday, the group of Americans and Israelis joined the Palestinian farmers hoping their presence would help them harvest in peace. T'ruah said the action was called Protect the Harvest.
paras.zh: 周三，这群美国人和以色列人加入了巴勒斯坦农民的行列，希望他们的存在能够帮助他们和平地收割庄稼。特鲁阿说，这次行动被称为“保护丰收”。

paras.en: After roughly two hours, drones began circling overhead and Israeli security forces arrived and declared the area a closed military zone. They detained the Israeli and American activists and took them to the police station for questioning. The rabbinical human rights group T'ruah said a Palestinian family was also detained.
paras.zh: 大约两个小时后，无人机开始在上空盘旋，以色列安全部队抵达并宣布该地区为军事禁区。他们拘留了以色列和美国活动人士，并将他们带到警察局接受审问。拉比人权组织 T'ruah 表示，一个巴勒斯坦家庭也被拘留。

paras.en: "Let us be clear about what happened here: Rather than protecting Palestinian farmers and ensuring their right to work their own land, the Israeli military forcibly removed those who came to provide a protective presence," T'ruah CEO Rabbi Jill Jacobs said in a statement. "This is an outrageous abuse of power, and part of a systematic, state-backed campaign of ethnic cleansing aimed at driving Palestinians from their land," she said.
paras.zh: T'ruah 首席执行官拉比·吉尔·雅各布斯 (Rabbi Jill Jacobs) 在一份声明中表示：“让我们明确一下这里发生的事情：以色列军方没有保护巴勒斯坦农民并确保他们在自己的土地上耕作的权利，而是强行驱逐了前来提供保护的人员。”她说：“这是对权力的粗暴滥用，是国家支持的系统性种族清洗运动的一部分，旨在将巴勒斯坦人赶出他们的土地。”

paras.en: Israeli authorities have rejected accusations of ethnic cleansing.
paras.zh: 以色列当局否认了种族清洗的指控。

paras.en: Lander, an ally of New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani who won the Democratic primary for a New York House district in June, has been an outspoken critic of the Israeli government.
paras.zh: 兰德是纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 的盟友，后者于 6 月赢得了纽约众议院选区的民主党初选，一直是以色列政府的直言不讳的批评者。

paras.en: This is a developing news story, which may be updated.
paras.zh: 这是一个正在发展的新闻报道，可能会更新。

paras.en: Daniel Estrin reported from Tel Aviv, Israel, where Itay Stern also contributed reporting.
paras.zh: 丹尼尔·埃斯特林 (Daniel Estrin) 从以色列特拉维夫报道，伊泰·斯特恩 (Itay Stern) 也参与了报道。

articles.title: Giants bench Jameis Winston, will start JJ McCarthy weeks after trading for him: report

paras.en: Big Blue is making a big change at quarterback.
paras.zh: 蓝色巨人在四分卫位置上做出了重大改变。

paras.en: The New York Giants are benching Jameis Winston and starting J.J. McCarthy on Sunday against the Houston Texans, according to ESPN.
paras.zh: 纽约巨人队将杰梅斯·温斯顿 (Jameis Winston) 放在替补席上，让 J.J.据 ESPN 报道，麦卡锡将于周日对阵休斯敦德州人队。

paras.en: Less than a month after acquiring McCarthy in a trade with the Minnesota Vikings, the Giants are turning to the 23-year-old quarterback to try to lead them to the playoffs in a weakened NFC East.
paras.zh: 在与明尼苏达维京人队交易得到麦卡锡不到一个月后，巨人队开始求助于这位 23 岁的四分卫，试图带领他们在国联东部实力较弱的情况下进入季后赛。

paras.en: After being used in packages in the Giants’ 27-27 tie with the Washington Commanders in Week 5, McCarthy saw significant action during the fourth quarter of the Giants’ 34-27 loss to the New Orleans Saints and thrived.
paras.zh: 在第 5 周巨人队 27-27 战平华盛顿指挥官队的比赛中，麦卡锡在巨人队 27-34 输给新奥尔良圣徒队的第四节中发挥了重要作用，并表现出色。

paras.en: McCarthy took over for Winston when the Giants were down 34-10 in the fourth quarter. He threw an interception on his first possession but then led a furious comeback attempt. McCarthy completed 11 of 21 passes for 243 yards and one touchdown.
paras.zh: 当巨人队第四节10-34落后时，麦卡锡接替了温斯顿。他在第一次控球时就被拦截，但随后发起了猛烈的反击尝试。麦卡锡21次传球完成11次，推进243码，达阵1次。

paras.en: McCarthy led three scoring drives, the first ending with a Tyrone Tracy Jr. rushing touchdown and a successful two-point conversion to make it 34-18. He then threw a 24-yard touchdown pass to Isaiah Likely, but the two-point conversion attempt failed, leaving the score at 34-24. He then led a field goal drive to cut the deficit to 34-27.
paras.zh: 麦卡锡带领球队三次得分，第一次结束时，小蒂龙·特雷西冲球达阵，并成功命中两分，将比分改写为34-18。随后他将24码达阵传球给以赛亚·利克里(Isaiah Likely)，但两分转换尝试失败，比分变为34-24。随后他带队投篮，将比分差距缩小到34-27。

paras.en: The No. 10 overall pick in the 2024 NFL Draft led the Giants down the field and gave them a chance to tie or win the game if coach John Harbaugh decided to go for two, but his fourth-down pass attempt from the Saints' 14-yard line sailed high.
paras.zh: 这位 2024 年 NFL 选秀中的 10 号新秀带领巨人队在球场上领先，如果教练约翰·哈博 (John Harbaugh) 决定投两球，他们就有机会打平或赢得比赛，但他在圣徒队 14 码线的第四次向下传球尝试却打得很高。

paras.en: While the comeback fell short, McCarthy impressed and made history in the process. His 243 yards are the most passing yards in the fourth quarter by any player this season and the second most by a quarterback who did not start the game over the past 25 seasons, according to NFL Network.
paras.zh: 虽然复出未能如愿，但麦卡锡给人留下了深刻的印象，并在此过程中创造了历史。据 NFL Network 报道，他的 243 码是本赛季所有球员第四节传球码数最多的球员，也是过去 25 个赛季未首发的四分卫中第二多的传球码数。

paras.en: The Giants went 2-1-1 with Winston at quarterback, but the 32-year-old struggled against the Saints. He threw two costly interceptions as the Giants attempted to rally against his former team.
paras.zh: 温斯顿担任四分卫，巨人队战绩为2-1-1，但这位32岁的球员在对阵圣徒队的比赛中表现不佳。当巨人队试图重整旗鼓对抗他的前球队时，他两次被拦截，代价高昂。

paras.en: The Giants hope the more mobile McCarthy can spark a struggling running game that has faltered with Winston at quarterback. McCarthy was the team’s leading rusher with 26 yards in Sunday's loss.
paras.zh: 巨人队希望移动能力更强的麦卡锡能够激发一场在四分卫温斯顿的带领下陷入困境的跑动比赛。在周日的比赛中，麦卡锡以 26 码的成绩成为球队的领先冲球手。

paras.en: Some believed an easier debut as the starter for McCarthy would come after the Giants’ bye week, which follows the Texans game, but the Giants decided otherwise.
paras.zh: 一些人认为麦卡锡作为先发球员的首次亮相将在巨人队与德州人队比赛之后的轮空周之后进行，但巨人队却另有决定。

paras.en: The Giants are 3-2-1 and sit atop the NFC East, with the Philadelphia Eagles, Dallas Cowboys and Washington Commanders all struggling and battling injuries, leaving New York with an opportunity to win the division.
paras.zh: 巨人队目前战绩为 3-2-1，位居国联东部榜首，而费城老鹰队、达拉斯牛仔队和华盛顿指挥官队都在与伤病作斗争，这让纽约队有机会赢得分区冠军。

articles.title: El-Sayed's past Muslim Brotherhood comments raise red flags as he eyes powerful role

paras.en: Abdul El-Sayed’s past support for Muslim Brotherhood protesters in Egypt is raising eyebrows in Congress after a former staffer for the left-wing Michigan Senate candidate says he's angling for a seat on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee if elected in November.
paras.zh: 阿卜杜勒·赛义德过去对埃及穆斯林兄弟会抗议者的支持引起了国会的关注，这位左翼密歇根州参议院候选人的一名前工作人员表示，如果他在 11 月当选，他将争取在参议院外交关系委员会获得一个席位。

paras.en: Two Republican panel members said there is no place on the committee for "radical views" held by El-Sayed, who has associated with controversial streamer Hasan Piker but has attempted during his bid for office to distance himself from the socialist arm of the Democratic Party.
paras.zh: 两名共和党小组成员表示，委员会中不容许埃尔赛义德持有的“激进观点”，他与有争议的流媒体哈桑·皮克有联系，但在竞选期间试图与民主党的社会主义分支保持距离。

paras.en: "A man with ties to the Muslim Brotherhood, who cheered their takeover of Egypt 15 years ago, and who campaigns with people saying America deserved 9/11, should not come anywhere near the U.S. Senate — and especially not the Foreign Relations Committee," Sen. Mike Lee, R-Utah, who serves on the power panel, told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: “一个与穆斯林兄弟会有联系的人，他在 15 年前为他们接管埃及而欢呼，并且与人们一起竞选，称美国应该遭受 9/11，他不应该接近美国参议院，尤其是外交关系委员会，”权力委员会成员、犹他州共和党参议员迈克·李 (Mike Lee) 告诉福克斯新闻数字频道。

paras.en: Sen. Dave McCormick, R-Pa., another member of the committee, responded to the controversy on X over the weekend.
paras.zh: 该委员会的另一位成员、宾夕法尼亚州共和党参议员戴夫·麦考密克 (Dave McCormick) 周末在 X 节目上回应了这一争议。

paras.en: "El-Sayed says he’s running on affordability, so why does he want a seat on @SenateForeign?" McCormick wrote. "I sit on that committee, and someone with El-Sayed's radical views has no business on it."
paras.zh: “埃尔-赛义德说他是靠负担能力竞选的，那么他为什么想在@SenateForeign 上获得一个席位呢？”麦考密克写道。 “我是该委员会的成员，持有埃尔-赛义德激进观点的人与此无关。”

paras.en: McCormick’s post came in response to a report by The Midwesterner that featured comments from Jordan Domingue, who worked as El-Sayed’s security chief during his 2018 campaign for Michigan governor.
paras.zh: 麦考密克的帖子是对《中西部人》一篇报道的回应，该报道刊登了乔丹·多明格的评论，多明格在 2018 年竞选密歇根州州长期间担任埃尔-赛义德的安全主管。

paras.en: "It is extremely difficult to comprehend how dangerous this can be if he is elected," Domingue wrote on X. "It’s especially troubling knowing that despite no foreign policy experience, he REALLY wants a seat on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee."
paras.zh: 多明格在 X 上写道：“很难理解，如果他当选，这会是多么危险。尤其令人不安的是，尽管他没有外交政策经验，但他确实想在参议院外交关系委员会占有一席之地。”

paras.en: In 2011, while working as an assistant professor at Columbia University, El-Sayed wrote an op-ed for The Huffington Post urging the Obama administration to support protesters associated with Egypt’s Muslim Brotherhood.
paras.zh: 2011年，在哥伦比亚大学担任助理教授期间，埃尔-赛义德为《赫芬顿邮报》撰写了一篇专栏文章，敦促奥巴马政府支持与埃及穆斯林兄弟会有关的抗议者。

paras.en: El-Sayed argued that supporting the protesters was in the U.S. interest and wrote that even if the Muslim Brotherhood overthrew Egypt’s government, the resulting state would not necessarily resemble Iran.
paras.zh: 赛义德认为，支持抗议者符合美国的利益，并写道，即使穆斯林兄弟会推翻了埃及政府，最终的国家也不一定会像伊朗那样。

paras.en: "It is in America’s interest to support Egyptian protesters’ efforts to achieve the ability to speak their mind and have a say in how they are governed," El-Sayed wrote . "If the U.S. truly wants to be the beacon of justice and liberty that it claims it does, it would behoove the Obama administration to fall decisively behind the protesters in Egypt."
paras.zh: 埃尔-赛义德写道：“支持埃及抗议者努力实现表达自己的想法并在治理方式上拥有发言权，这符合美国的利益。” “如果美国真的想像它所声称的那样成为正义和自由的灯塔，那么奥巴马政府就应该坚决支持埃及的抗议者。”

paras.en: In a recent town hall, however, El-Sayed, the son of Egyptian immigrant parents, said he does disavow the Muslim Brotherhood. His campaign did not respond to Fox News Digital’s request about his 2011 op-ed about protesters.
paras.zh: 然而，在最近的一次市政厅会议上，埃及移民父母的儿子埃尔赛义德表示，他确实不认同穆斯林兄弟会。他的竞选团队没有回应福克斯新闻数字频道关于他 2011 年有关抗议者的专栏文章的请求。

paras.en: The Muslim Brotherhood-backed government took power in Egypt in 2012 but was ousted by the military in 2013.
paras.zh: 穆斯林兄弟会支持的政府于 2012 年在埃及掌权，但于 2013 年被军方推翻。

paras.en: El-Sayed has throughout his campaign emphasized healthcare, lowering gas and grocery prices and addressing the cost-of-living crisis, as noted by McCormick in his post about the candidate's reported interest in the Foreign Relations Committee.
paras.zh: 正如麦考密克在他关于候选人对外交关系委员会的兴趣的帖子中所指出的那样，埃尔·赛义德在整个竞选过程中都强调医疗保健、降低汽油和杂货价格以及解决生活成本危机。

paras.en: "It shouldn’t be this hard to get by in the richest, most powerful country in the world," El-Sayed said during his primary campaign against Rep. Haley Stevens, D-Mich., and state Sen. Mallory McMorrow.
paras.zh: “在世界上最富有、最强大的国家生存不应该这么困难，”埃尔赛义德在初选期间与密歇根州民主党众议员海莉·史蒂文斯和州参议员马洛里·麦克莫罗一起说道。

paras.en: McCormick wonders why, given that context, El-Sayed would be gunning for a spot on a committee that deals solely with issues related to U.S. foreign relations.
paras.zh: 麦考密克想知道为什么在这种背景下，埃尔赛义德会在一个专门处理与美国外交关系相关问题的委员会中谋取一席之地。

articles.title: Manchin calls Schumer 'crazy' for trying to oust GOP senator in crucial Senate showdown

paras.en: LEWISTON, MAINE – Former Sen. Joe Manchin, a longtime Democrat turned independent, took aim at Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer on Wednesday for trying to unseat Republican Sen. Susan Collins of Maine, calling his former party leader's efforts "crazy" as he joined Collins on the campaign trail in her high-stakes re-election race.
paras.zh: 缅因州刘易斯顿 — — 前参议员乔·曼钦 (Joe Manchin) 是一位长期担任民主党人的独立人士，他周三将矛头指向参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默 (Chuck Schumer)，因为他试图推翻缅因州共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯 (Susan Collins)，他称前党魁在与柯林斯一起参与高风险连任竞选活动时的努力“疯狂”。

paras.en: Collins, a moderate Republican who at times has voted against President Donald Trump and her party, is fighting for her political life as she runs for a sixth six-year term representing blue-leaning Maine in the Senate. She is the only GOP senator seeking re-election in a state Trump lost in the 2024 election
paras.zh: 柯林斯是一位温和的共和党人，有时会投票反对唐纳德·特朗普总统及其政党，她正在为自己的政治生涯而奋斗，代表偏蓝的缅因州竞选参议院的第六个六年任期。她是特朗普在 2024 年大选中落败的州中唯一寻求连任的共和党参议员

paras.en: The race between Collins and Troy Jackson, a former state Senate president, is a top flip opportunity for Democrats as they try to win back the Senate majority from Republicans in the midterm elections. The latest public opinion polls indicate a margin-of-error showdown, and the latest Fox News Power Rankings rate the race as a toss-up, as do leading nonpartisan political handicappers the Cook Political Report, Inside Elections and Sabato's Crystal Ball.
paras.zh: 柯林斯和前州参议院主席特洛伊·杰克逊之间的竞选对于民主党来说是一个绝佳的翻转机会，因为他们试图在中期选举中从共和党手中夺回参议院多数席位。最新的民意调查显示一场误差幅度的摊牌，最新的福克斯新闻权力排名将这场竞选评为势均力敌，主要的无党派政治障碍者库克政治报告、内部选举和萨巴托的水晶球也是如此。

paras.en: Manchin, who worked closely with Collins during his years in the Senate, was asked by Fox News Digital how his campaigning with his former colleague would sit with Schumer, the top Democrat in the chamber.
paras.zh: 曼钦在参议院任职期间与柯林斯密切合作，福克斯新闻数字频道询问他与前同事的竞选活动将如何与众议院民主党领袖舒默坐在一起。

paras.en: "Chuck Schumer would not be surprised of me being with my dear friend. There is no surprise there at all. I told him he was crazy in 2020 from working against her so hard and he’s crazy now to work against her," Manchin said, as he referred to unsuccessful efforts by Democrats to defeat Collins in her re-election six years ago, and their current push to oust her.
paras.zh: 曼钦说：“查克·舒默不会对我和我亲爱的朋友在一起感到惊讶。这并不奇怪。我告诉他，他在 2020 年因为如此努力地与她作对而变得疯狂，而现在他也疯狂地与她作对。”他指的是六年前民主党在柯林斯连任中击败她的努力失败，以及他们目前推动驱逐她的努力。

paras.en: Manchin emphasized, "This is not right. She is the soul of America. She is the soul of the Senate and he knows he needs more Susan Collins, no matter what side of the aisle they’re on. This is ridiculous."
paras.zh: 曼钦强调，“这是不对的。她是美国的灵魂。她是参议院的灵魂，他知道他需要更多苏珊·柯林斯，无论他们站在哪一边。这太荒谬了。”

paras.en: Fox News Digital reached out to Schumer's political team and the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee for a comment, but did not receive a response at the time this story was published.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字联系了舒默的政治团队和民主党参议员竞选委员会征求意见，但在本文发表时尚未收到回复。

paras.en: A former West Virginia governor who served in the Senate from 2010 to 2025, Manchin frequently broke with his party, frustrating Democratic Presidents Barack Obama and Joe Biden, as well as Schumer and other Senate Democratic leaders.
paras.zh: 曼钦曾是西弗吉尼亚州州长，曾于 2010 年至 2025 年担任参议院议员，他经常与党派决裂，令民主党总统巴拉克·奥巴马和乔·拜登以及舒默和其他参议院民主党领导人感到沮丧。

paras.en: As he works to oust Collins from the Senate, Jackson has repeatedly tried to anchor the senator to Trump, who has seen his approval ratings in Maine and across the country drop further underwater.
paras.zh: 在努力将柯林斯赶出参议院的过程中，杰克逊多次试图将这位参议员与特朗普联系起来，而特朗普在缅因州和全国各地的支持率进一步下降。

paras.en: But Manchin said that Collins is "not a Trump senator. She's not a Republican senator or a Democrat senator. She's an American senator that represents her state of Maine ... the most the most independent minded person I've ever met."
paras.zh: 但曼钦表示，柯林斯“不是特朗普参议员。她不是共和党参议员或民主党参议员。她是代表缅因州的美国参议员……是我见过的最独立思想的人。”

paras.en: Collins noted that "Joe and I were part of every bipartisan initiative that passed the Senate and became law during the years that we worked together... .I just so enjoy our partnership in getting things done for Maine, for West Virginia and for America."
paras.zh: 柯林斯指出，“在我们共同努力的这些年里，乔和我参与了通过参议院并成为法律的每一项两党倡议……我非常享受我们的合作伙伴关系，为缅因州、西弗吉尼亚州和美国完成工作。”

paras.en: Manchin and Collins spoke with reporters after met with restaurant workers and customers at Simones' Hot Dog Stand, a famed local eatery in downtown Lewiston that's been serving customers for a century. It was the first of two campaign stops in Maine's 2nd Congressional District, key swing district.
paras.zh: 曼钦和柯林斯在西蒙斯热狗摊会见了餐厅工作人员和顾客后接受了记者采访。西蒙斯热狗摊是刘易斯顿市中心当地一家著名的餐馆，已经为顾客服务了一个世纪。这是缅因州第二国会选区（关键摇摆选区）两次竞选活动中的第一站。

paras.en: Collins and Jackson last week faced-off on the debate stage for the fourth and final time. The senator used the debates to showcase how her Senate seniority has helped her deliver federal funding for Maine. Meanwhile, Jackson used the showdowns to position himself as an outsider who understands the struggles and frustrations of working-class voters.
paras.zh: 柯林斯和杰克逊上周在辩论舞台上第四次也是最后一次对峙。这位参议员利用辩论来展示她的参议院资历如何帮助她为缅因州提供联邦资金。与此同时，杰克逊利用摊牌将自己定位为一个了解工人阶级选民的挣扎和挫折的局外人。

paras.en: Jackson won a special nominating convention in late July to claim the party's Senate nomination, which was left vacant after primary winner Graham Platner ended his campaign following allegations he raped a woman he previously dated. Platner denied the allegations but dropped out.
paras.zh: 杰克逊在七月下旬举行的一次特别提名大会上获胜，获得了该党的参议院提名，而初选获胜者格雷厄姆·普拉特纳因被指控强奸了他之前约会过的一名女性而结束了竞选活动，该提名一直空缺。普拉特纳否认了这些指控，但退出了。

paras.en: Jackson, who earlier this year unsuccessfully ran for the Democratic gubernatorial nomination, had campaigned alongside Platner during the primary campaign.
paras.zh: 杰克逊今年早些时候竞选民主党州长提名失败，但他在初选期间与普拉特纳一起竞选。

paras.en: Collins, meanwhile, has a history of surviving Democratic efforts to unseat her.
paras.zh: 与此同时，柯林斯也曾在民主党试图推翻她的努力中幸存下来。

paras.en: Six years ago, she trailed Democratic challenger Sara Gideon, the Maine House speaker at the time, but Collins won re-election by nearly nine points while former President Joe Biden carried the state by a similar margin.
paras.zh: 六年前，她落后于民主党挑战者、当时的缅因州众议院议长萨拉·吉迪恩，但柯林斯以近九个百分点的优势赢得连任，而前总统乔·拜登也以类似的优势赢得了该州的支持。

paras.en: Fox News' Kailey Schuyler contributed to this story
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻的 Kailey Schuyler 对本文做出了贡献

articles.title: Putin orders release of jailed American as he meets Trump envoy for Ukraine talks
articles.author: Pjotr Sauer

paras.en: Vladimir Putin ordered the release of an American from a Russian jail as he met Donald Trump’s envoy Steve Witkoff in St Petersburg on Wednesday for fresh talks on ending the war in Ukraine, amid increasingly close relations between Moscow and Washington.
paras.zh: 周三，在莫斯科和华盛顿关系日益密切之际，弗拉基米尔·普京在圣彼得堡会见了唐纳德·特朗普的特使史蒂夫·威特科夫，就结束乌克兰战争进行了新的会谈，并下令从俄罗斯监狱释放一名美国人。

paras.en: Trump had previously asked Putin to free Stephen Hubbard, a 74-year-old former teacher who had spent more than four years in Russian jails on charges of fighting as a mercenary for Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特朗普此前曾要求普京释放74岁的前教师史蒂芬·哈伯德(Stephen Hubbard)，他因被指控作为乌克兰雇佣兵而在俄罗斯监狱里呆了四年多。

paras.en: His release appeared to be Moscow’s latest calculated move to bring Trump further into line with Putin’s position on Ukraine, while offering the US president a diplomatic victory before the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 释放他似乎是莫斯科精心策划的最新举措，目的是让特朗普进一步与普京在乌克兰问题上的立场保持一致，同时为美国总统在中期选举前带来外交胜利。

paras.en: Hubbard was released unilaterally by Russia, rather than as part of a prisoner exchange as has often been the case with previous releases of Americans held in the country.
paras.zh: 哈伯德是被俄罗斯单方面释放的，而不是像以前释放在该国关押的美国人那样，作为囚犯交换的一部分。

paras.en: Writing on social media after the release was announced, Trump said it followed a request he had made “directly” to Putin last week.
paras.zh: 消息公布后，特朗普在社交媒体上写道，这是他上周“直接”向普京提出的请求。

paras.en: He wrote on Truth Social: “The United States, out of respect for President Trump, was not required to give anything in return – an unprecedented situation for Russia … There was no ‘swap’ necessary for this release.”
paras.zh: 他在《Truth Social》上写道：“出于对特朗普总统的尊重，美国不需要给予任何回报——这对俄罗斯来说是前所未有的情况……这次释放没有必要进行‘交换’。”

paras.en: Witkoff, meanwhile, lavished praise on Putin during their meeting at the grand Constantine Palace in St Petersburg, describing the Russian president as a humanitarian.
paras.zh: 与此同时，维特科夫在圣彼得堡宏伟的君士坦丁宫会晤期间对普京大肆赞扬，称俄罗斯总统是一位人道主义者。

paras.en: “You talk so much about my president, President Trump, being a humanitarian. You are a humanitarian also, sir, and I salute that,” Witkoff told Putin. He also conveyed Trump’s thanks for a deal to resume Russian diesel exports to the US.
paras.zh: “你经常谈论我的总统特朗普总统是一名人道主义者。先生，你也是一名人道主义者，我对此表示敬意，”维特科夫对普京说。他还转达了特朗普对恢复俄罗斯向美国柴油出口的协议的感谢。

paras.en: The Russian president is wanted by the international criminal court (ICC) as a war criminal, in relation to the deportation of Ukrainian children to Russia during the war. More than 17,500 civilians have been confirmed killed in Ukraine since Russia launched its full-scale invasion in February 2022, according to the UN, which says the true toll is likely to be significantly higher.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统因战争期间将乌克兰儿童驱逐到俄罗斯而被国际刑事法院（ICC）作为战犯通缉。据联合国称，自俄罗斯于 2022 年 2 月发动全面入侵以来，乌克兰已确认有超过 17,500 名平民被杀，而真正的死亡人数可能要高得多。

paras.en: The warmth of Witkoff’s remarks stood in stark contrast to the increasingly hostile rhetoric directed at Volodymyr Zelenskyy by senior US officials, most notably Trump, who has called for the Ukrainian president to resign and portrayed him as the main obstacle to peace.
paras.zh: 维特科夫的热情言论与美国高级官员（尤其是特朗普）针对弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基日益敌对的言论形成了鲜明对比，特朗普呼吁乌克兰总统辞职，并将他描述为和平的主要障碍。

paras.en: Witkoff travelled to Russia from Oslo, where he had met Zelenskyy and European leaders a day earlier in an attempt to inject momentum into stalled negotiations, with Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine now in its fifth year.
paras.zh: 维特科夫从奥斯陆前往俄罗斯，一天前他在那里会见了泽伦斯基和欧洲领导人，试图为陷入僵局的谈判注入动力，目前俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰已进入第五个年头。

paras.en: Witkoff told Putin during a televised portion of their meeting: “We’ve brought some papers. It’s really some ideas, some sort of peace deal between Russia and Ukraine, and you’ll read that at your leisure.”
paras.zh: 维特科夫在会议的电视转播部分告诉普京：“我们带来了一些文件。这实际上是一些想法，俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的某种和平协议，你可以在闲暇时阅读。”

paras.en: The visit was Witkoff’s ninth to Russia since Trump tasked him with brokering an end to the war.
paras.zh: 这是自特朗普委托他斡旋结束战争以来，威特科夫第九次访问俄罗斯。

paras.en: The latest rupture in relations between Washington and Kyiv was triggered by Trump’s surprise decision to lift sanctions on Russian diesel as part of a deal with Putin, followed by his call for Zelenskyy to be replaced after Ukraine refused to halt its strikes on Russian oil refineries.
paras.zh: 华盛顿和基辅之间关系的最新破裂是由于特朗普出人意料地决定取消对俄罗斯柴油的制裁，作为与普京达成协议的一部分，随后在乌克兰拒绝停止对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击后，他呼吁泽伦斯基被替换。

paras.en: Kyiv has since complained of disruptions to US intelligence-sharing and restrictions on its access to Starshield, the military-grade version of Elon Musk’s Starlink satellite network.
paras.zh: 此后，基辅抱怨美国情报共享受到干扰，并限制其访问星盾（埃隆·马斯克星链卫星网络的军用版本）。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said on Tuesday that Washington had resumed providing advance warnings of Russian missile attacks after his meeting with Witkoff in Oslo.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周二表示，在奥斯陆与维特科夫会面后，华盛顿已恢复对俄罗斯导弹袭击发出预警。

paras.en: But Ukraine continues to face restrictions on Starshield, although it remains unclear who ordered them. The Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday that Musk had personally ordered the slowdown, while Reuters, citing sources, said the directive had come from inside the White House.
paras.zh: 但乌克兰继续面临星盾的限制，尽管尚不清楚是谁下令的。 《华尔街日报》周二报道称，马斯克亲自下令减速，而路透社援引消息人士的话称，该指令来自白宫内部。

paras.en: During Wednesday’s meeting with Witkoff, Putin thanked Trump and his wife, Melania, for “their attention to efforts to end the war”. Witkoff said there was “some degree of momentum” behind efforts to reach a peace deal, describing the talks in Oslo as “constructive”.
paras.zh: 在周三与威特科夫的会面中，普京感谢特朗普和他的妻子梅拉尼娅“对结束战争努力的关注”。维特科夫表示，达成和平协议的努力背后存在“一定程度的动力”，并称奥斯陆会谈是“建设性的”。

paras.en: Yet there are few signs of an imminent breakthrough. Despite repeated Ukrainian calls for a ceasefire, including a halt to attacks on energy infrastructure, Moscow has given little indication that it intends to end its bombardment of Ukraine as winter approaches, apparently confident that continued pressure will help it extract greater concessions from Kyiv.
paras.zh: 然而，几乎没有迹象表明即将取得突破。尽管乌克兰一再呼吁停火，包括停止对能源基础设施的袭击，但莫斯科几乎没有表示打算在冬季临近时结束对乌克兰的轰炸，显然相信持续的压力将有助于其从基辅获得更大的让步。

paras.en: The Russian leader remains intent on sticking to his maximalist war aims, including his demand for full Russian control of Ukraine’s eastern Donetsk region.
paras.zh: 这位俄罗斯领导人仍然决心坚持其最高限度的战争目标，包括要求俄罗斯完全控制乌克兰东部顿涅茨克地区。

paras.en: After the Witkoff meeting, the Kremlin said it was open to new three-way peace talks between Russia, Ukraine and US, which could take place in Abu Dhabi and would be focused on how to guarantee the security of Ukraine and Russia once the war ended.
paras.zh: 维特科夫会议后，克里姆林宫表示，对俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国之间新的三方和平谈判持开放态度，谈判可能在阿布扎比举行，重点讨论战争结束后如何保障乌克兰和俄罗斯的安全。

paras.en: Putin also sought to emphasise the prospects for closer economic ties between Russia and the US once the war ends, suggesting that Moscow could significantly increase its exports of fertilisers to the American market.
paras.zh: 普京还试图强调战争结束后俄罗斯和美国之间更紧密的经济联系的前景，暗示莫斯科可能会大幅增加对美国市场的化肥出口。

paras.en: Russian officials said the first tanker carrying diesel to the US would depart on Thursday as part of an initial shipment of about 300,000 tonnes.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官员表示，第一艘向美国运送柴油的油轮将于周四启航，这是首批约 30 万吨柴油的一部分。

paras.en: Energy analysts and traders have questioned whether Trump’s agreement to temporarily resume Russian diesel imports will deliver meaningful relief to US consumers before the midterm elections, arguing that the volumes involved are too small to significantly ease the global supply squeeze.
paras.zh: 能源分析师和交易员质疑特朗普同意暂时恢复俄罗斯柴油进口是否会在中期选举前为美国消费者带来有意义的缓解，他们认为涉及的数量太小，无法显着缓解全球供应紧张。

paras.en: The talks on Wednesday also touched on a possible meeting in China next month between Putin, Trump and the Chinese president, Xi Jinping. The Kremlin said Beijing was already making preparations for what it described as an unprecedented summit between the three leaders.
paras.zh: 周三的会谈还涉及普京、特朗普和中国国家主席习近平下个月可能在中国举行的会晤。克里姆林宫表示，北京已经在为三位领导人之间前所未有的峰会做准备。

articles.title: Taiwan charges five men over plot to run over comedian for his Xi Jinping jokes
articles.author: Guardian staff

paras.en: Taiwanese prosecutors have charged five men over a plot to ram a car into a comedian who made fun of the Chinese Communist party and Xi Jinping.
paras.zh: 台湾检察官指控五名男子密谋用汽车撞向一位取笑中国共产党和习近平的喜剧演员。

paras.en: Taiwan has repeatedly accused China of transnational repression to silence critics on the self-governed island, which Beijing claims as its territory and has vowed to take by force if necessary.
paras.zh: 台湾一再指责中国进行跨国镇压，以压制这个自治岛屿上的批评者。北京声称该岛是其领土，并誓言在必要时将使用武力夺取该岛。

paras.en: In one performance, Huang Yi-hao insulted the Chinese leader’s appearance, compared him to Winnie-the-Pooh and tore into his political record.
paras.zh: 在一场表演中，黄一豪侮辱了中国领导人的外貌，将他比作小熊维尼，并撕毁了他的政治记录。

paras.en: Prosecutors in New Taipei said on Wednesday that an individual from mainland China who was identified as “K” had paid the five defendants to injure Huang badly enough to require hospitalisation.
paras.zh: 新北检方周三表示，一名来自中国大陆、被称为“K”的人向五名被告付钱，将黄重伤至需要住院治疗。

paras.en: The prosecutors said: “This case involves a serious incident in which the Chinese Communist party is suspected of using cross-border suppression tactics to direct lawless elements in our country to suppress dissenting political voices through extreme violence.”
paras.zh: 检方表示：“本案涉及中共涉嫌采用跨境打压手段，指挥我国不法分子通过极端暴力镇压不同政治声音的严重事件。”

paras.en: China’s Taiwan Affairs Office did not respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 中国台湾事务办公室没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: A GPS tracker was allegedly put on Huang’s scooter months before the attack to identify his daily routines, Taiwan’s Central News Agency said. On 11 September, two defendants drove into Huang’s bike as he rode home, but stopped after hearing Huang scream, prosecutors said.
paras.zh: 台湾中央通讯社称，据称在袭击发生前几个月，黄的摩托车上安装了 GPS 追踪器，以识别他的日常生活。检察官称，9 月 11 日，两名被告在黄骑回家时撞上了他的自行车，但在听到黄尖叫后停了下来。

paras.en: The comedian was left with a bruised pelvis and the suspects then allegedly pretended to help with an insurance claim in order to send a photo of Huang’s medical certificate to K.
paras.zh: 这位喜剧演员的骨盆受伤，嫌疑人随后假装帮助办理保险索赔，以便将黄的医疗证明照片发送给 K。

paras.en: K refused to pay the full sum of NT$450,000 (US$13,900; £10,370) promised to the suspects because Huang’s injuries were only minor, the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称，K拒绝支付承诺给嫌疑人的全额新台币45万元（13,900美元；10,370英镑），因为黄的伤势较轻。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Huang reposted a video from December 2025 in which he asked the audience to help him by shouting out the name of the person he was about to describe.
paras.zh: 周三，黄转发了 2025 年 12 月的一段视频，视频中他请求观众帮助他喊出他要描述的人的名字。

paras.en: In a fast-paced diatribe, the comedian, dressed in a traditional gown, evoked “swept-back hair” and a “plump figure”, and criticised policies on Hong Kong, Covid and the property market. After finishing with an expletive, the crowd chanted back Xi’s name before breaking into applause.
paras.zh: 在快节奏的谩骂中，这位身着传统长袍的喜剧演员展现出“后梳头发”和“丰满身材”，并批评了香港、新冠疫情和房地产市场的政策。在一声咒骂结束后，人群高喊习近平的名字，然后爆发出掌声。

paras.en: In May, two people were prosecuted after spreading faeces and paint at a Taipei club hours before a Huang show.
paras.zh: 今年五月，两人因在黄仁勋演出前几个小时在台北一家俱乐部散布粪便和油漆而被起诉。

paras.en: Lev Nachman, a professor of political science at National Taiwan University, said: “It is important to remember that what we are reading about is obviously a more extreme case, but there have been threats and acts of violence against critics of the Communist party here in Taiwan for many years.”
paras.zh: 国立台湾大学政治学教授列夫·纳赫曼(Lev Nachman)表示：“重要的是要记住，我们所读到的显然是一个更极端的案例，但台湾多年来一直存在针对共产党批评者的威胁和暴力行为。”

paras.en: Taiwan’s Mainland Affairs Council said in October that at least 126 individuals had been affected by Chinese transnational repression.
paras.zh: 台湾陆委会10月表示，至少有126人受到中国跨国镇压的影响。

paras.en: The Guardian has contacted the Chinese foreign ministry for comment.
paras.zh: 《卫报》已联系中国外交部请其置评。

paras.en: In a post on Wednesday, Huang said: “If people can be subjected to this kind of treatment simply for criticising the Chinese Communist party when it does not even govern Taiwan, how can we expect to retain our current freedom of speech if the CCP were ever to rule Taiwan?”
paras.zh: 黄在周三的一篇帖子中说：“如果人们仅仅因为批评中国共产党而遭受这种待遇，而中国共产党甚至没有统治台湾，那么如果中国共产党统治台湾，我们怎么能指望保留目前的言论自由呢？”

paras.en: In another post on Facebook, Huang said he would not cancel future performances but that he was “no hero”.
paras.zh: 黄在脸书上的另一篇帖子中表示，他不会取消未来的演出，但他“不是英雄”。

paras.en: “I write it because it’s funny,” he said. “If I stop, it will only be because I’ve got bored of it.”
paras.zh: “我写它是因为它很有趣，”他说。 “如果我停下来，那只是因为我厌倦了。”

articles.title: Controversial US-backed vaccine trial in African newborns halted
articles.author: Melody Schreiber

paras.en: The US-backed hepatitis B vaccine trial in African newborns that drew global backlash was halted, the lead researcher said on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 首席研究员周三表示，美国支持的针对非洲新生儿的乙型肝炎疫苗试验已停止，该试验引起了全球的强烈反对。

paras.en: It is “now clear” that the study “will not move forward in Guinea-Bissau”, Frederik Schaltz-Buchholzer, a Danish researcher, wrote on LinkedIn, adding, “we were not given the necessary governmental approval.”
paras.zh: 丹麦研究员 Frederik Schaltz-Buchholzer 在 LinkedIn 上写道，“现在很清楚”，这项研究“不会在几内亚比绍取得进展”，并补充道，“我们没有获得必要的政府批准。”

paras.en: The minister of health in Guinea-Bissau, Quinhin Nantote, previously denied that the project would move forward. “This is not even remotely true,” Nantote told the Guardian in Portuguese last week.
paras.zh: 几内亚比绍卫生部长奎因·南托特此前否认该项目将继续推进。 “这根本不是真的，”南托特上周用葡萄牙语告诉《卫报》。

paras.en: The study was to be funded with $1.6m from the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), along with another $1.6m from private partners like the Bill Ackman-backed Pershing Square Foundation and the Bluebell Foundation.
paras.zh: 该研究将获得美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 的 160 万美元资助，以及比尔·阿克曼支持的潘兴广场基金会 (Pershing Square Foundation) 和风信子基金会 (Bluebell Foundation) 等私人合作伙伴的另外 160 万美元资助。

paras.en: “The solution is clear here: Take the money and vaccinate as many kids as you can,” said Paul Offit, a vaccines expert at the Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia, who sharply criticized the proposed study as unethical.
paras.zh: 费城儿童医院的疫苗专家保罗·奥菲特（Paul Offit）表示：“解决方案很明确：拿钱给尽可能多的孩子接种疫苗。”他严厉批评这项拟议的研究不道德。

paras.en: The government of Guinea-Bissau now has control over the researchers’ vaccines, which they apprehended when they searched the offices of the Bandim Health Project on Monday.
paras.zh: 几内亚比绍政府现在控制了研究人员的疫苗，他们在周一搜查班迪姆健康项目的办公室时截获了这些疫苗。

paras.en: It is vital to support Guinea-Bissau in rolling the immunizations out to all newborns as soon as possible, Offit said. Guinea-Bissau currently plans to offer the universal birth dose in 2028.
paras.zh: 奥菲特说，支持几内亚比绍尽快向所有新生儿推出免疫接种至关重要。几内亚比绍目前计划在 2028 年提供全民出生剂量。

paras.en: The Danish researchers, led by Schaltz-Buchholzer, Christine Stabell Benn and Peter Aaby, hypothesized giving live vaccines, like the Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG), may have an overall mortality benefit beyond simply preventing illnesses like tuberculosis – but giving another vaccine like hepatitis B alongside it could dampen that effect.
paras.zh: 由 Schaltz-Buchholzer、Christine Stabell Benn 和 Peter Aaby 领导的丹麦研究人员假设，接种卡介苗 (BCG) 等活疫苗可能不仅能预防结核病等疾病，还能降低总体死亡率，但同时接种乙型肝炎等另一种疫苗可能会削弱这种效果。

paras.en: Such a hypothesis is “fanciful” because the hepatitis B vaccine is a single protein among billions encountered by the immune system each day, Offit said.
paras.zh: 奥菲特说，这种假设是“异想天开”，因为乙型肝炎疫苗只是免疫系统每天遇到的数十亿种蛋白质中的一种。

paras.en: “There’s no evidence for that, and it doesn’t make biological sense,” he continued. He also added that there was a very clear benefit to giving the vaccine to babies as soon as possible, because of high rates of hepatitis B in the country and the possibility of lifelong illness and death from infection.
paras.zh: “没有证据证明这一点，而且这没有生物学意义，”他继续说道。他还补充说，尽快给婴儿接种疫苗有非常明显的好处，因为该国乙型肝炎发病率很高，并且有可能导致终身患病和因感染而死亡。

paras.en: The Danish researchers did not respond by press time to questions about the study or to this criticism. The CDC did not respond by press time to questions about whether the funding, which was appropriated through its global health work, would now be used to roll out the vaccine to all newborns in Guinea-Bissau, as recommended by the World Health Organization (WHO).
paras.zh: 截至发稿时，丹麦研究人员尚未对有关该研究的问题或批评做出回应。截至发稿时，疾病预防控制中心尚未回应有关是否按照世界卫生组织（WHO）的建议，将通过其全球卫生工作拨出的资金用于向几内亚比绍的所有新生儿接种疫苗的问题。

paras.en: “WHO recommends that all infants receive a first dose of the hepatitis B vaccine as soon as possible after birth – preferably within 24 hours – followed by at least 2 additional doses,” said Tarik Jašarević, a WHO spokesperson. “WHO remains committed to working with national authorities, researchers, and partners to ensure that all newborns – in Guinea‑Bissau and worldwide – receive timely, evidence‑based protection against hepatitis B.”
paras.zh: 世卫组织发言人塔里克·贾萨雷维奇 (Tarik Jašarević) 表示：“世卫组织建议所有婴儿在出生后尽快接种第一剂乙型肝炎疫苗——最好是在 24 小时内——然后至少再接种两剂。” “世卫组织仍然致力于与国家当局、研究人员和合作伙伴合作，确保几内亚比绍和全世界的所有新生儿都能及时获得基于证据的乙型肝炎保护。”

paras.en: Those who declined participation in the study would not have received the vaccines – making true informed consent impossible, experts say.
paras.zh: 专家表示，那些拒绝参与该研究的人将不会接种疫苗，从而不可能获得真正的知情同意。

paras.en: “Imagine you’re a mother. You want to do the best for your child,” said Henrik Støvring, a Danish researcher who has co-published research raising questions about previous research from the Bandim project.
paras.zh: “想象一下，你是一位母亲。你想为你的孩子做最好的事情，”丹麦研究人员 Henrik Støvring 说，他与他人共同发表的研究对 Bandim 项目之前的研究提出了质疑。

paras.en: “If they decide to participate in the trial, they have a 50% chance of getting the vaccine for their children. But if they stay out, they have a 0% chance of getting the vaccine. So how can you say that’s a non-coercive informed consent?” Støvring asked.
paras.zh: “如果他们决定参加试验，他们有 50% 的机会为孩子接种疫苗。但如果他们不参加，他们获得疫苗的机会为 0%。那么你怎么能说这是非强制性的知情同意呢？”斯托夫林问道。

paras.en: The proposed trial led to distrust among Bissau-Guineans, who wondered if the vaccine – which has a decades-long record of being safe and effective – was being tested on Africans because it was dangerous, Schaltz-Buchholzer said in his post.
paras.zh: 沙尔茨-布赫霍尔泽在他的帖子中说，拟议的试验引起了几内亚比绍人的不信任，他们想知道这种疫苗——这种疫苗拥有数十年的安全有效记录——正在非洲人身上进行测试，因为它很危险。

paras.en: It “should be clear” that both birth vaccination schedules – with or without hepatitis B – are not “dangerous to anyone”, he wrote. There is a clear benefit to giving hepatitis B vaccines at birth, and not doing so can lead to lifelong danger, experts say.
paras.zh: 他写道，“应该明确”的是，无论是否接种乙型肝炎，两种出生疫苗接种计划都不会“对任何人造成危险”。专家表示，出生时接种乙型肝炎疫苗有明显的好处，但不这样做可能会导致终生危险。

paras.en: Conducting a study like this “makes the case that there’s something that’s worthy of study, for which they have no evidence,” Offit said.
paras.zh: 奥菲特说，进行这样的研究“证明有一些东西值得研究，但他们没有证据”。

paras.en: “We have millions and millions, arguably hundreds of millions, of children in this world who have gotten that vaccine as a birth dose or haven’t. If there was any evidence that this was problematic, you would know this by now,” Offit added. “We eliminated hepatitis B in the United States in children virtually within years of starting that program, so the benefits are clear.”
paras.zh: “世界上有数百万，可以说是数亿儿童，他们在出生时接种了疫苗，或者没有接种。如果有任何证据表明这是有问题的，你现在就会知道了，”奥菲特补充道。 “在开始该计划后的几年内，我们几乎在美国儿童中消除了乙型肝炎，因此好处是显而易见的。”

paras.en: Schaltz-Buchholzer also cast doubt on the effectiveness and safety of the hepatitis B vaccine at birth, noting that he believes the study was canceled because it challenges “prevailing medical assumptions, such as that HBV0 does not have non-specific effects”. The study, in addition to looking at mortality, would have also examined side effects like skin conditions and neurodevelopmental conditions. Dozens of studies have shown no link between vaccination and autism.
paras.zh: Schaltz-Buchholzer 还对出生时乙型肝炎疫苗的有效性和安全性表示怀疑，并指出他认为这项研究被取消是因为它挑战了“普遍的医学假设，例如 HBV0 不具有非特异性效应”。该研究除了关注死亡率之外，还检查了皮肤状况和神经发育状况等副作用。数十项研究表明疫苗接种与自闭症之间没有联系。

paras.en: “All newborns should be given a birth dose of hepatitis B vaccine,” Offit said. “Guinea-Bissau is a country that suffers a high incidence of chronic hepatitis B. That country, more than any other country, arguably, needs to launch this program.”
paras.zh: “所有新生儿都应该接种出生剂量的乙型肝炎疫苗，”奥菲特说。 “几内亚比绍是一个慢性乙型肝炎发病率很高的国家。可以说，该国比任何其他国家都更需要启动该计划。”

articles.title: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots

paras.en: French President Emmanuel Macron has accused foreign leaders of exploiting the riots which erupted across the country on Saturday for electoral purposes.
paras.zh: 法国总统马克龙指责外国领导人利用周六全国爆发的骚乱来达到选举目的。

paras.en: Without naming them, he said they were campaigning for forthcoming elections "at France's expense" with their comments on the violence, which erupted on the fringe of cost-of-living protests.
paras.zh: 他没有透露他们的名字，但表示他们正在“以法国为代价”为即将举行的选举进行竞选活动，并发表了对暴力事件的评论，这些暴力事件是在生活费用抗议活动的边缘爆发的。

paras.en: Speaking on a visit to the Middle East, he referred to them as "leaders who are in campaign mode, whether here in the region or on the other side of the Atlantic".
paras.zh: 在访问中东时，他将他们称为“处于竞选模式的领导人，无论是在该地区还是在大西洋彼岸”。

paras.en: It was an apparent swipe at Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who faces parliamentary elections next week, and US President Donald Trump, for whom mid-term polls fall next month.
paras.zh: 这显然是对下周将面临议会选举的以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡和下个月中期民意调查将落下的美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的抨击。

paras.en: Macron said the unnamed leaders had been influenced by fake videos generated by AI about the riots.
paras.zh: 马克龙表示，这些未透露姓名的领导人受到了人工智能生成的有关骚乱的虚假视频的影响。

paras.en: Nearly 150 people have been jailed and more than 800 brought before the courts since the riots which gripped Paris and other cities including Lyon, Marseille and Nice.
paras.zh: 自巴黎以及里昂、马赛和尼斯等其他城市发生骚乱以来，已有近 150 人被监禁，800 多人被送上法庭。

paras.en: Video of running battles between masked rioters and police, as well as property being destroyed and stores being looted, spread across social media.
paras.zh: 蒙面暴徒与警察之间的战斗以及财产被破坏和商店被抢劫的视频在社交媒体上传播。

paras.en: The government admitted the police had "lost control" during the violence, which came after weeks of protests by students over conditions in high schools.
paras.zh: 政府承认警方在暴力事件中“失去了控制”，此前学生针对高中条件进行了数周的抗议。

paras.en: Macron vowed afterwards that the authorities would be "uncompromising" towards "agitators from ultra-left fringe groups", which he blamed for much of the trouble.
paras.zh: 马克龙事后发誓，当局将对“极左边缘团体的煽动者”采取“毫不妥协”的态度，他指责这些人造成了大部分麻烦。

paras.en: Speaking in the Qatari capital Doha, the French president said: "For me, there is no visible foreign interference in the events that took place. On the other hand, there was foreign manipulation of information afterwards, yes, and that gave rise to unacceptable and stupid comments from many people, including foreign leaders...
paras.zh: 法国总统在卡塔尔首都多哈发表讲话时表示：“对我来说，所发生的事件没有明显的外国干涉。另一方面，事后确实存在外国操纵信息的情况，这引起了包括外国领导人在内的许多人的不可接受和愚蠢的评论......

paras.en: "We had people claiming that we had been invaded by hordes of migrants and Islamists, which is completely false."
paras.zh: “有人声称我们遭到了大批移民和伊斯兰主义者的入侵，这完全是错误的。”

paras.en: On Tuesday, Netanyahu said in an interview for Israel's i24 channel, external that France, which has Western Europe's largest Muslim minority, had been hit by an "invasion of extremist Islam".
paras.zh: 周二，内塔尼亚胡在接受以色列i24频道对外采访时表示，拥有西欧最大穆斯林少数民族的法国受到了“伊斯兰极端主义入侵”的打击。

paras.en: He said he had told Macron after the Hamas attack on Israel on 7 October 2023: "If we do not eliminate them here, you will have them in Paris." "That is exactly what is happening," he added.
paras.zh: 他说，2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯袭击以色列后，他曾告诉马克龙：“如果我们不在这里消灭他们，他们就会在巴黎。” “这正是正在发生的事情，”他补充道。

paras.en: Also on Tuesday, Trump blamed the riots on mass immigration to France.
paras.zh: 同样在周二，特朗普将骚乱归咎于法国的大规模移民。

paras.en: "When I look at France, when you look at Italy, when you look at all the turmoil and the hatred, that's not about school," he said. "That's about people coming into the countries that hate the country."
paras.zh: “当我看到法国，当你看到意大利，当你看到所有的骚乱和仇恨，这与学校无关，”他说。 “这是关于人们进入仇恨这个国家的国家。”

paras.en: "Close your borders and take control before it is too late!" he said in remarks directed at Macron.
paras.zh: “关闭边境并控制住一切，以免为时已晚！”他在针对马克龙的讲话中说道。

paras.en: According to a report in the UK's Financial Times newspaper, external, EU regulators are examining possible foreign online interference and disinformation campaigns around the French riots and similar recent outbursts of unrest in EU states.
paras.zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，外部，欧盟监管机构正在审查围绕法国骚乱以及欧盟国家最近爆发的类似骚乱可能存在的外国在线干扰和虚假信息活动。

paras.en: It quotes unnamed security officials as saying that pro-Russian and far-right social media accounts linked to previous disinformation campaigns have spread violent videos in an attempt to sow more chaos.
paras.zh: 报道援引未透露姓名的安全官员的话说，与之前的虚假信息活动有关的亲俄罗斯和极右翼社交媒体账户传播了暴力视频，试图制造更多混乱。

paras.en: Iran and Algeria are also suspected of being behind some of the messaging, the paper adds.
paras.zh: 该报补充说，伊朗和阿尔及利亚也被怀疑是某些信息的幕后黑手。

paras.en: David Colon, a researcher at France's Sciences Po university who specialises in disinformation, was quoted as saying that "pro-Kremlin influencers" linked to the Russian campaign Storm-1516 had "amplified the events and spread a number of false narratives".
paras.zh: 法国巴黎政治大学专门研究虚假信息的研究员戴维·科隆 (David Colon) 表示，与俄罗斯 Storm-1516 活动有关的“亲克里姆林宫影响者”“放大了事件并传播了一些虚假叙述”。

paras.en: France is one of Ukraine's most vociferous military supporters in its ongoing war with Russia, while Algeria is a former French colony with bitter memories of its war to achieve independence in 1962, and French relations with Iran have been strained by its war with the US and Israel this year.
paras.zh: 法国是乌克兰在与俄罗斯持续战争中最强烈的军事支持者之一，而阿尔及利亚是前法国殖民地，对其1962年争取独立的战争有着痛苦的记忆，法国与伊朗的关系因今年与美国和以色列的战争而紧张。

paras.en: BBC Verify has reviewed more than 15 examples of fake news videos on social media which researchers at the US-based dTeam say are the work of a Russian disinformation operation known as Matryoshka.
paras.zh: BBC verify 审查了社交媒体上超过 15 个虚假新闻视频的例子，美国 dTeam 的研究人员表示，这些视频是俄罗斯一个名为“俄罗斯套娃”的虚假信息组织所为。

paras.en: The videos feature near-identical branding to real news outlets in France, including Le Monde, Euronews and France 24.
paras.zh: 这些视频的品牌与法国真实的新闻媒体几乎相同，包括《世界报》、《欧洲新闻》和《法国 24 小时》。

paras.en: The individual impact and reach of videos made by Matryoshka appear to be limited, but experts have said the focus on amplifying unrest is consistent with known Russian disinformation tactics.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯套娃制作的视频的个人影响力和影响范围似乎有限，但专家表示，其重点是扩大骚乱，这与俄罗斯已知的虚假信息策略是一致的。

paras.en: Separately, BBC Verify has traced one of the most viral AI-generated images circulating on social media, which supposedly shows an elderly couple being robbed and left in their underwear in Paris, to an obscure website.
paras.zh: 另外，BBC verify 追踪到了社交媒体上流传最广的人工智能生成图像之一，据称该图像显示一对老年夫妇在巴黎被抢劫，并只穿内衣被留在了一个不起眼的网站上。

paras.en: The director of Infos-Israel.News, Sabrina Hania, told the BBC her team had created the image - which was published on 17 October - using ChatGPT without using a reference image.
paras.zh: Infos-Israel.News 的主管 Sabrina Hania 告诉 BBC，她的团队使用 ChatGPT 创建了该图像（并于 10 月 17 日发布），而没有使用参考图像。

paras.en: It was posted shortly after a television journalist reported on the alleged incident, citing "police information". The claim remains unconfirmed, with French media reporting that prosecutors have no information supporting it having happened.
paras.zh: 一名电视记者援引“警方信息”报道了这起事件后不久就发布了这篇文章。这一说法尚未得到证实，法国媒体报道称，检察官没有任何信息支持这件事的发生。

paras.en: While the original image was labelled as "Made with AI" on X and "AI content" on Instagram, it was later shared on X without any disclaimer in a post which attracted more than six million views.
paras.zh: 虽然原始图像在 X 上被标记为“AI 制作”，在 Instagram 上被标记为“AI 内容”，但随后在 X 上分享，且没有任何免责声明，该帖子吸引了超过 600 万次观看。

paras.en: Hania said she regretted that the image had been taken out of context and had misled so many people, blaming those who reshared it without identifying it as AI-generated.
paras.zh: 哈尼亚表示，她对这张图片被断章取义并误导了很多人感到遗憾，并指责那些转发该图片而没有将其识别为人工智能生成的人。

articles.title: Russia says it is ready to resume talks with Ukraine and US to end war

paras.en: Russia is "ready in principle" to resume talks with the US and Ukraine on ending the conflict, Vladimir Putin's top aide has said.
paras.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京的高级助手表示，俄罗斯“原则上准备好”恢复与美国和乌克兰就结束冲突进行的谈判。

paras.en: Yuri Ushakov was speaking after Putin met US President Donald Trump's special envoy Steve Witkoff in the Russian city of St Petersburg.
paras.zh: 尤里·乌沙科夫是在普京在俄罗斯圣彼得堡会见美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的特使史蒂夫·维特科夫后发表上述讲话的。

paras.en: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky and its European allies have been pressing Moscow for an immediate resumption of the talks suspended in February, and Ushakov said a new round could be held next month, possibly in Abu Dhabi.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基及其欧洲盟友一直向莫斯科施压，要求其立即恢复二月份暂停的会谈，乌沙科夫表示，下个月可能会在阿布扎比举行新一轮会谈。

paras.en: Russia has for months refused talks as it believes it is winning on the battlefield with Ukraine facing an acute shortage of interceptors against deadly Russian missile attacks.
paras.zh: 几个月来，俄罗斯一直拒绝谈判，因为它相信自己正在战场上获胜，而乌克兰面临着针对致命的俄罗斯导弹袭击的拦截器的严重短缺。

paras.en: Witkoff went to St Petersburg after meeting Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky as well as the leaders of Norway and Finland on Monday in Oslo. Ushakov said their ideas were not very "useful".
paras.zh: 维特科夫周一在奥斯陆会见了乌克兰总统泽连斯基以及挪威和芬兰领导人后前往圣彼得堡。乌沙科夫表示，他们的想法不太“有用”。

paras.en: Top officials from Russia, Ukraine and the US have held several rounds of talks aimed at ending the war that began in February 2022 when Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国高级官员举行了多轮会谈，旨在结束2022年2月普京全面入侵乌克兰而开始的战争。

paras.en: The talks, however, were put on hold, with the Kremlin blaming last month's "massive" Ukrainian strikes on Russia during its general elections for their disruption.
paras.zh: 然而，会谈被搁置，克里姆林宫指责上个月乌克兰在大选期间对俄罗斯进行的“大规模”袭击造成了破坏。

paras.en: Speaking to reporters after Wednesday's talks in St Petersburg, Ushakov suggested that a new round could be held around 10 November in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates.
paras.zh: 周三在圣彼得堡举行会谈后，乌沙科夫对记者表示，新一轮会谈可能于 11 月 10 日左右在阿拉伯联合酋长国首都阿布扎比举行。

paras.en: He stressed that the talks must focus on "building a security system for Russia and Ukraine after the end of the conflict."
paras.zh: 他强调，会谈的重点必须是“在冲突结束后为俄罗斯和乌克兰建立安全体系”。

paras.en: A US official later told the BBC that Witkoff and Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner, another key negotiator, had proposed at Tuesday's talks in the Norwegian capital "a trilateral meeting at the technical level between the US, Russia, and Ukraine".
paras.zh: 一名美国官员后来告诉 BBC，威特科夫和特朗普的女婿、另一位关键谈判代表贾里德·库什纳在周二于挪威首都举行的会谈中提议“美国、俄罗斯和乌克兰之间举行技术层面的三边会议”。

paras.en: "This was accepted by the Ukrainians in Oslo yesterday and by the Russians in St Petersburg today," said the official, who spoke on condition of anonymity.
paras.zh: 这位不愿透露姓名的官员说：“昨天在奥斯陆的乌克兰人和今天在圣彼得堡的俄罗斯人都接受了这一点。”

paras.en: Ushakov also told reporters that President Putin reiterated to Witkoff that Russian troops were advancing everywhere across the vast front line and had a "strategic initiative".
paras.zh: 乌沙科夫还告诉记者，普京总统向维特科夫重申，俄罗斯军队正在广阔的前线各地推进，并拥有“战略主动权”。

paras.en: Ukraine and its European allies are disputing Putin's claim, pointing to a virtual stalemate on the front.
paras.zh: 乌克兰及其欧洲盟友对普京的主张提出质疑，指出前线实际上陷入了僵局。

paras.en: The talks in Oslo and St Petersburg were held amid a growing row between Ukraine and the US.
paras.zh: 奥斯陆和圣彼得堡的会谈是在乌克兰和美国之间的争端日益加剧之际举行的。

paras.en: Trump has said it is time for Ukraine to get a new president, and most recently "for somebody else to negotiate on behalf of Ukraine".
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，现在是乌克兰选出新总统的时候了，最近是“让其他人代表乌克兰进行谈判”。

paras.en: Ahead of next month's US midterm elections, Trump has also sought to blame Ukraine's attacks on Russian oil refineries for fuel prices which have been rising since the start of the US-led war on Iran.
paras.zh: 在下个月的美国中期选举之前，特朗普还试图将自美国领导的伊朗战争开始以来燃油价格上涨归咎于乌克兰对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击。

paras.en: European leaders have expressed concern about recent US statements towards Russia.
paras.zh: 欧洲领导人对美国最近针对俄罗斯的言论表示担忧。

articles.title: Family of prison officer killed by IRA receives state apology

paras.en: The family of a senior Irish prison officer murdered by the IRA has received a state apology on Wednesday for failings in investigations into his killing.
paras.zh: 周三，一名被爱尔兰共和军谋杀的爱尔兰高级监狱官员的家人因对其谋杀案的调查失败而收到国家道歉。

paras.en: Brian Stack, a father of three, was crossing a street in Dublin, after leaving a boxing match in 1983, when he was shot in the back of the neck.
paras.zh: 1983 年，布莱恩·斯塔克 (Brian Stack) 是三个孩子的父亲，他在结束一场拳击比赛后在都柏林过马路时，脖子后面中弹。

paras.en: Stack, who was the chief prison officer at the high-security Portlaoise Prison, was left paralysed and died 18 months later, aged 49.
paras.zh: 斯塔克是戒备森严的波特劳伊斯监狱的监狱长，他全身瘫痪，18 个月后去世，享年 49 岁。

paras.en: There were three separate garda (Irish police) investigations into Stack's death, but no-one was brought to justice for his killing.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰警方对斯塔克的死亡进行了三项独立调查，但没有人因杀害斯塔克而被绳之以法。

paras.en: The Taoiseach (Irish Prime Minister) MicheÃ¡l Martin offered an apology on behalf of the state during a sitting of the DÃ¡il (Irish parliament).
paras.zh: 爱尔兰总理迈克尔·马丁在爱尔兰议会会议上代表国家道歉。

paras.en: Stack's wife Sheila and her sons Austin, Kieran and Oliver were in the chamber for the apology.
paras.zh: 斯塔克的妻子希拉和她的儿子奥斯汀、基兰和奥利弗在会议厅接受道歉。

paras.en: Martin said the Provisional IRA is "still in the possession of all the facts" on this case.
paras.zh: 马丁表示，临时爱尔兰共和军“仍掌握此案的所有事实”。

paras.en: The Stack brothers left the DÃ¡il (lower house of Irish parliament) chamber when Sinn FÃ©in TDs spoke during the State apology.
paras.zh: 当新芬党议员在国家道歉期间发表讲话时，斯塔克兄弟离开了爱尔兰议会下议院。

paras.en: Speaking outside Leinster House after the State apology, Austin Stack called on Sinn FÃ©in leader Mary Lou McDonald to "address our concerns" around their father's murder.
paras.zh: 国家道歉后，奥斯汀·斯塔克在伦斯特宫外发表讲话，呼吁新芬党领导人玛丽·卢·麦克唐纳“解决我们对他们父亲被谋杀的担忧”。

paras.en: "The IRA were responsible for the murder my father. The leader of the opposition has consistently said that the IRA campaign was justified," he said.
paras.zh: “爱尔兰共和军对谋杀我父亲负有责任。反对派领导人一直表示爱尔兰共和军的竞选活动是合理的，”他说。

paras.en: "The leader of the opposition did not dignify and respect my family by coming into the chamber today and because of that, we took the action that we did, in withdrawing from the chamber when Sinn FÃ©in representatives were speaking."
paras.zh: “反对派领导人今天进入会议厅没有尊严和尊重我的家人，因此，我们采取了我们所做的行动，在新芬党代表发言时退出会议厅。”

paras.en: Speaking to reporters in Belfast, where she was being interviewed by the Police Service of Northern Ireland in relation to protests at Garvaghy Road, McDonald welcomed the State apology.
paras.zh: 麦克唐纳在贝尔法斯特接受记者采访时表示，她对政府的道歉表示欢迎。

paras.en: "I can only imagine the trauma that they have been through for a long time," she said.
paras.zh: “我只能想象他们长期以来所经历的创伤，”她说。

paras.en: "The IRA has acknowledged responsibility and expressed sorrow for the death of Brian Stack, has said that it shouldn't have happened and I think they made those statements very clearly more than a decade ago and I think that was the right and the correct thing to do."
paras.zh: “爱尔兰共和军承认了责任，并对布莱恩·斯塔克的死表示哀悼，并表示这不应该发生，我认为他们在十多年前就已经非常明确地发表了这些声明，我认为这是正确且正确的做法。”

paras.en: In a further statement, a Sinn FÃ©in spokesperson said a number of senior party TDs made contributions in the DÃ¡il, and that it was regrettable that McDonald was unable to attend due to her scheduled police interview.
paras.zh: 新芬党发言人在进一步声明中表示，多名党内高级官员在众议院做出了贡献，令人遗憾的是麦克唐纳因预定的警方面谈而无法出席。

paras.en: "Our thoughts are with Sheila Stack and her sons. Brian Stack's killing was wrong and should never have happened. We are deeply sorry for their loss and suffering.
paras.zh: “我们的心与希拉·斯塔克和她的儿子们同在。布莱恩·斯塔克被杀是错误的，根本不应该发生。我们对他们的损失和痛苦深感抱歉。”

paras.en: "Sinn FÃ©in acknowledges the hurt caused by republican actions in the past. We welcome the Irish government's apology for the investigative failures that compounded the family's pain. They deserve truth and justice.
paras.zh: “新芬党承认共和党过去的行动所造成的伤害。我们欢迎爱尔兰政府对调查失败而道歉，这些失败加剧了这个家庭的痛苦。他们应该得到真相和正义。

paras.en: "Our position is clear: Investigating Brian Stack's killing is the responsibility of An Garda SÃochÃ¡na. We support that work and the family's right to answers."
paras.zh: “我们的立场很明确：调查布莱恩·斯塔克被杀是警察局的责任。我们支持这项工作以及家人获得答案的权利。”

paras.en: Speaking to BBC Radio Ulster's Good Morning Ulster programme Brian Stack's son, Austin Stack, said the apology "means an awful lot to us".
paras.zh: 布莱恩·斯塔克 (Brian Stack) 的儿子奥斯汀·斯塔克 (Austin Stack) 在接受 BBC 阿尔斯特广播电台的《早安阿尔斯特》节目时表示，道歉“对我们来说意义重大”。

paras.en: "It's a great sense of comfort, to particularly my mother and to myself and my two brothers, because the state is officially owning up to the errors and the omissions that happened," he said.
paras.zh: “这是一种极大的安慰，特别是对我的母亲、我自己和我的两个兄弟来说，因为国家正式承认所发生的错误和遗漏，”他说。

paras.en: He went on to say that the serious crime review team looked into the first investigation and "they found 194 errors and omissions".
paras.zh: 他接着说，严重犯罪审查小组对第一次调查进行了调查，“他们发现了 194 个错误和遗漏”。

paras.en: "So I have, and my family have, met with several ministers for justice down through the years and we have a requested sight of that report.
paras.zh: “多年来，我和我的家人会见了几位司法部长，我们要求查看这份报告。

paras.en: "And every time we've requested it, we've been told that it's an internally valid document and that we cannot see it."
paras.zh: “每次我们提出要求时，我们都会被告知这是一份内部有效的文件，我们看不到它。”

paras.en: Austin Stack said that Wednesday would be a very emotional day for his family.
paras.zh: 奥斯汀·斯塔克表示，周三对他的家人来说将是非常激动的一天。

paras.en: "My dad was doing a very difficult job at a very difficult time in our history," he said.
paras.zh: “在我们历史上非常困难的时期，我父亲正在做一项非常困难的工作，”他说。

paras.en: "He was awarded the Irish Prison Service's highest bravery award for that work that he was doing. And this is further vindication of him and his good name."
paras.zh: “他因所做的工作而被爱尔兰监狱管理局授予最高勇敢奖。这进一步证明了他和他的好名声。”

paras.en: Prior to the DÃ¡il proceedings, the Stack family held a private meeting at government buildings with the taoiseach and Minister for Justice Jim O'Callaghan.
paras.zh: 在众议院审理之前，斯塔克家族在政府大楼与爱尔兰总理和司法部长吉姆·奥卡拉汉举行了一次私人会议。

paras.en: In 2007 the Garda Commissioner directed a review of the case by the Garda Serious Crime Review Team. Over 200 recommendations were made relating to the cases.
paras.zh: 2007 年，警察专员指示警察严重犯罪审查小组对此案进行审查。针对这些案件提出了 200 多项建议。

paras.en: This review led to "serious failings" being found as well as "the shortcomings in the management" of the earlier Garda investigation.
paras.zh: 此次审查发现了警方早期调查的“严重失误”以及“管理上的缺陷”。

paras.en: These failures, listed by Martin in the DÃ¡il, are: failure to keep a map made of the crime scene, a failure to keep a motorbike helmet found near the crime scene and linked to the crime, a failure to keep custody of material exhibits, including various fingerprints, samples and debris gathered during the investigation.
paras.zh: 马丁在《众议院》中列出的这些失败包括：未能保存犯罪现场地图、未能保存在犯罪现场附近发现的与犯罪有关的摩托车头盔、未能保管好物证，包括调查期间收集的各种指纹、样本和碎片。

paras.en: The taoiseach also said there was a failure to document some potentially important aspects of the original investigation, including whether Brian's colleagues at Portlaoise Prison were interviewed and whether prisoners at the prison were interviewed.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰总理还表示，未能记录最初调查的一些可能重要的方面，包括布莱恩在波特劳伊斯监狱的同事是否接受了采访，以及监狱中的囚犯是否接受了采访。

paras.en: There was also a failure to interview the Stack family and to interview Brian's wider group of friends.
paras.zh: 采访斯塔克家族和布莱恩更广泛的朋友群也失败了。

paras.en: "It is plainly and utterly unacceptable that material that was potentially of evidential value to the investigation can no longer be located by An Garda SÃochÃ¡na.
paras.zh: “警察无法再找到对调查具有潜在证据价值的材料，这显然是完全不可接受的。

paras.en: "It is admitted by An Garda SÃochÃ¡na that these are serious matters that had an impact on the investigation," Martin said.
paras.zh: 马丁说：“警察局承认这些都是影响调查的严重问题。”

paras.en: He formally apologised to the Stack family for these failings.
paras.zh: 他为这些失误正式向斯塔克家族道歉。

paras.en: Speaking in the Commons during Northern Ireland questions on Wednesday, Secretary of State Sir Chris Bryant said he "warmly welcomed" the apology.
paras.zh: 周三，国务卿克里斯·布莱恩特爵士在北爱尔兰问题下议院发表讲话时表示，他“热烈欢迎”这一道歉。

paras.en: Asked about the matter by Democratic Unionist Party leader Gavin Robinson, Sir Chris said Dublin doing so was "entirely right and proper" and went to the heart of discussions MPs had been having this week as they debated the UK government's Troubles legacy bill.
paras.zh: 在被民主统一党领袖加文·罗宾逊问及此事时，克里斯爵士表示，都柏林的做法“完全正确”，并触及了议员们本周在辩论英国政府的麻烦遗产法案时进行的讨论的核心。

paras.en: He added that it was "incumbent on all of us to make fulsome and not mealy-mouthed apologies".
paras.zh: 他补充说，“我们所有人都有责任做出充分而不是口头上的道歉”。

paras.en: The IRA admitted killing Stack in 2013 after his family mounted a long campaign to secure the admission, and met Sinn FÃ©in's Gerry Adams and a former IRA commander.
paras.zh: 2013 年，爱尔兰共和军承认杀害了斯塔克，此前斯塔克的家人为确保其入狱进行了长期的努力，并会见了新芬党的格里·亚当斯和一名前爱尔兰共和军指挥官。

paras.en: Adams, at that time, expressed his "regret" to the Stack family over the killing.
paras.zh: 亚当斯当时向斯塔克家族表达了对这起杀戮的“遗憾”。

paras.en: A Sinn FÃ©in spokesperson said that "in a 2013 statement, a former IRA leader acknowledged that IRA volunteers were responsible for Brian Stack's killing".
paras.zh: 新芬党发言人表示，“在 2013 年的一份声明中，一位前爱尔兰共和军领导人承认爱尔兰共和军志愿者对布莱恩·斯塔克的杀戮负有责任”。

paras.en: "The statement said the shooting had not been authorised by the IRA leadership, accepted IRA responsibility for his death, said it should not have happened and expressed sorrow for the pain and hurt suffered by the family."
paras.zh: “声明称，枪击事件未经爱尔兰共和军领导层授权，承认爱尔兰共和军对他的死亡负有责任，表示这件事不应该发生，并对家人遭受的痛苦和伤害表示哀悼。”

paras.en: The spokesperson added: "As republicans, we acknowledge the hurt caused by republican actions. That suffering cannot be disowned. We are sorry for all the lives lost during the period of conflict on this island, without exception."
paras.zh: 该发言人补充道：“作为共和党人，我们承认共和党的行为所造成的伤害。这种痛苦是无法否认的。我们对岛上冲突期间所有丧生的人无一例外表示歉意。”

paras.en: Irish foreign affairs minister Helen McEntee also spoke during the State apology, she said: "The State failed you during their investigation into Brian's killing."
paras.zh: 爱尔兰外交部长海伦·麦肯蒂也在国家道歉期间发表讲话，她说：“国家在调查布莱恩被杀事件期间让你们失望了。”

paras.en: She said Brian was "targeted" by the Provisional IRA and said "they are responsible".
paras.zh: 她说布莱恩是临时爱尔兰共和军的“目标”，并表示“他们负有责任”。

paras.en: "To Sheila and to all of the Stack family, we are deeply sorry for all that you have endured, for the failures of the investigation and the additional suffering they have caused you, we are deeply sorry. I hope today's formal apology brings some measure of peace and comfort."
paras.zh: “对于希拉和斯塔克家族的全体成员，我们对你们所承受的一切、调查的失败以及给你们造成的额外痛苦深表歉意。我希望今天的正式道歉能够带来一定程度的平静和安慰。”

paras.en: Donegal Sinn FÃ©in TD (member of Irish parliament) Pearse Doherty said the Stack's family "long search for answers deserves respect".
paras.zh: 多尼戈尔·新芬党 (Donegal Sinn Féin TD)（爱尔兰议会议员）皮尔斯·多尔蒂 (Pearse Doherty) 表示，Stack 家族“对答案的长期探索值得尊重”。

paras.en: "No apology can restore Brian Stack's life or return the years spent seeking answers but it can recognise the wrong done."
paras.zh: “任何道歉都无法挽回布莱恩·斯塔克的生活，也无法挽回多年来寻求答案的时间，但它可以承认所犯的错误。”

paras.en: He said the failures of the garda investigation "compounded" the suffering of the Stack family.
paras.zh: 他说，警方调查的失败“加剧”了斯塔克家族的痛苦。

paras.en: In 2019, the family received an apology from then garda commissioner Drew Harris in relation to the handling of the investigation into the murder.
paras.zh: 2019年，该家人收到了时任警察局长德鲁·哈里斯(Drew Harris)就谋杀案调查处理事宜做出的道歉。

paras.en: In 2023, gardaÃ told the family that the file on the case - which was with the DPP (Director of Public Prosecutions) - was being sent back to police for further investigation.
paras.zh: 2023 年，警察告诉家人，DPP（检察长）的案件档案将被送回警方进行进一步调查。

paras.en: Stack was the only prisoner officer in the state killed by violence related to the Troubles in Northern Ireland.
paras.zh: 斯塔克是该州唯一一位因与北爱尔兰问题相关的暴力事件而丧生的囚犯官员。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.

articles.title: A Holiday Season of Giving

paras.en: This holiday season, Carlisle Brake & Friction’s Medina location is proud to support 15 children of our colleagues who could use a little extra cheer. Our employees have generously donated toys, clothing, and other essential items to bring joy to these young lives.

By coming together as a team, we’re demonstrating our commitment to making a positive impact on our community. We’re grateful for the kindness and generosity of our employees, and we hope this initiative will bring warmth and happiness to the children who receive these gifts.

A special preview of an AI-based product and the debut of a new product series will be featured at the show opening on Nov. 3. Special offers on select Hunter equipment will be available only to in-person SEMA attendees.
Dozens of Hunter representatives will be available in booth no. 42017, South Hall Lower, for personal consultations and hands-on demonstrations of Hunter equipment. New products will include:
